jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Company

At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.

Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.

About The Role

Flow is seeking a Director of Engineering
to oversee building operations, maintenance performance, and critical systems across a portfolio of multifamily communities.

This role serves as the operational leader for engineering teams within an assigned region, partnering closely with General Managers, Assistant General Managers, and onsite maintenance teams to ensure our communities operate safely, efficiently, and to Flow standards.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with leadership experience across multiple properties. They are equally comfortable walking a mechanical room, reviewing a maintenance budget, analyzing operational metrics, and mentoring onsite teams.

Responsibilities

Regional Operations

Provide technical and operational support to engineering teams across multiple communities
Ensure consistent execution of preventative maintenance programs, work orders, unit turns, and repair and maintenance activities
Conduct regular property visits, inspections, and operational audits to verify compliance with company standards
Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvements that enhance service delivery and resident experience
Support General Managers and onsite leadership teams with engineering-related challenges and escalations

Engineering & Building Systems

Monitor the performance, maintenance, and uptime of critical building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, elevators, generators, access control, and fire & life safety systems
Lead troubleshooting efforts and support remediation of major maintenance-related issues
Ensure preventative maintenance schedules are executed and documented properly
Assist with planning and execution of deferred maintenance projects and system upgrades
Identify life safety, employee safety, and physical hazards and develop corrective action plans

Vendor & Contract Management

Manage relationships with service providers and contractors across the portfolio
Review vendor performance, scope of work, and contract compliance
Participate in bid processes and vendor selection efforts
Conduct regular business reviews with key service partners to ensure quality, responsiveness, and value
Recommend opportunities for contract optimization and cost savings

Financial Performance

Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning efforts
Monitor maintenance expenses, turnover costs, and service contract expenditures
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency while maintaining service standards
Assist with evaluating repair-versus-replace decisions and long-term asset planning

Compliance & Safety

Ensure properties operate in accordance with all federal, state, and local regulations
Maintain compliance with OSHA, EPA, NFPA, and applicable building and life safety codes
Support safety training initiatives and reinforce company safety standards
Ensure all required inspections, testing, certifications, and documentation are completed on schedule

Team Leadership

Coach, develop, and support onsite engineering teams and maintenance leaders
Participate in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training of engineering personnel
Assist with performance management and succession planning efforts
Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement

Reporting & Performance Metrics

Monitor and evaluate key operational metrics including preventative maintenance completion, work order completion times, unit turn performance, resident service feedback, compliance inspections, budget performance, and critical systems uptime
Provide regular reporting and recommendations to leadership teams

Ideal Background

5+ years of engineering, facilities, or maintenance leadership experience within multifamily, hospitality, commercial real estate, or a related industry
Experience overseeing operations across multiple properties or locations
Strong knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical systems, elevators, and fire & life safety systems
Working knowledge of OSHA regulations, EPA requirements, and NFPA codes
Experience managing third-party vendors and service contracts
Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets and maintenance expenditures
Experience using Yardi or similar property management platforms
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills
Ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned portfolio
Bilingual English and Spanish fluency highly preferred

Benefits

We take care of our people so they can do their best work.

Health and Wellness Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance and parental leave benefits. On-staff doctor, free therapy through SpringHealth, acupuncture, an Employee Assistance Program, and other wellness offerings.
Time Off PTO and paid holidays.
Financial 401(k) retirement plan, healthcare and dependent care FSAs, HSA-compatible plan options with annual employer HSA funding and pre-tax commuter benefits.
Life at Flow Weekly catered lunches, wellness classes and employee discounts on Flow hotel stays, grocer products, and merch.

Flow is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and hires regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity and/or expression, pregnancy, Veteran status any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, we provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Mobile Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

ServiceNow is opening a new AI engineering hub in West Palm Beach and hiring the founding leaders who will define its culture, teams, and technical direction from day one. If you've wanted the ownership of a startup with the scale of a global enterprise — this is that moment.

About The Role

Build and lead a world-class Mobile Platform Engineering organization in West Palm Beach that powers AI-native enterprise experiences across iOS and Android. This leader will hire exceptional mobile and AI talent, establish an AI-forward engineering culture, and deliver scalable mobile platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications.

Build an AI-Native Engineering Culture in West Palm Beach

Establish and grow the Mobile Platform Engineering organization in West Palm Beach as a strategic hub for mobile and AI innovation.
Recruit, develop, and retain excellent AI, Android, iOS, and mobile platform engineering talent.
Embed AI-assisted development, automated quality systems, agentic workflows, and rapid experimentation into day-to-day engineering practices.
Create a high-performance culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, customer impact, and continuous learning.

Lead Mobile Platform Strategy and Execution

Own the technical roadmap for enterprise mobile platform capabilities across Android and iOS.
Establish and run on-call rotations, incident response processes, and a blameless postmortem culture that drives reliability improvements.
Define reusable frameworks, SDKs, and platform patterns that accelerate application development across multiple product teams.
Partner with Product, Design, AI, Infrastructure, and Business leaders to deliver differentiated mobile experiences.
Drive excellence in performance, reliability, security, scalability, and operational rigor across the mobile platform.

Architect Enterprise Mobile Experiences

Design mobile platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications across customer service, field service, operations, and productivity workflows.
Lead architecture for synchronization, offline-first experiences, notifications, inbox experiences, real-time interactions, and workflow execution.
Ensure applications perform reliably in low-connectivity and offline environments while meeting enterprise-grade security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
Create seamless experiences across mobile clients, AI services, platform capabilities, and enterprise workflows.

Provide Technical Leadership

Lead critical architecture reviews and complex technical decisions across mobile, platform integration, and application layers.
Own the mobile build and delivery pipeline, including CI/CD reliability, build speed and test infrastructure.
Establish standards for observability, telemetry, mobile performance benchmarking, release quality, and production readiness.
Mentor Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, and senior technical contributors.
Advance mobile innovation through AI-enabled workflows, modern development practices, and strong engineering fundamentals.

Why This Role

Engineering leadership roles that let you build a site from scratch — with a real charter, real resources, and real company-wide impact — are rare at any scale. This isn't a "manage the org" role. It's a "create the org" role.

For leaders who want to leave a mark on both the product and the people who build it, this is the opportunity.

Qualifications

12+ years of software engineering experience with significant experience leading mobile engineering organizations (Android and iOS).
3+ years leading engineering managers or multi-team organizations.
Strong technical depth in mobile architecture, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native services, networking, security, data synchronization, and MAM/MDM enterprise integrations.
Track record building and scaling enterprise-grade mobile applications or mobile platforms used at large scale.
Experience managing Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.

Specific AI Skills We Value

Experience building or integrating generative AI, LLM-powered experiences, AI agents, or copilots into mobile or enterprise applications.
Working knowledge of RAG, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and AI safety principles.
Familiarity with AI platforms and frameworks such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or comparable ecosystems.
Understanding of on-device AI patterns, small language models, speech or vision models, real-time inference constraints, and mobile latency tradeoffs.
Experience applying AI to engineering productivity, including code generation, test generation, automated review, incident analysis, or quality automation.
Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, secure, enterprise-grade mobile workflows.

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Your opportunity

At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

Wealth and Advice Solutions Technology (WAS Technology) is a strategic technology organization supporting Schwab's Wealth, Advisory, Banking, and Trust Services business. Our mission is to deliver innovative technology solutions that empower financial consultants, advisors, and clients through differentiated digital experiences and personalized financial guidance.

As a Director, Wealth Management Engineering, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping the future of technology supporting Schwab's high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) client experiences. You will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for delivering modern, scalable, and resilient platforms that enable advisors to serve clients more effectively while advancing Schwab's long-term technology strategy.

This role offers the unique opportunity to influence enterprise technology direction, partner with senior business and technology executives, and help accelerate modernization through cloud-native architectures, AI-enabled capabilities, and innovative engineering practices. If you are passionate about developing leaders, driving transformative change, and delivering technology solutions that directly impact clients and advisors, we'd love to hear from you.

Define and execute technology strategies that align with Wealth and Advice business objectives and long-term growth goals.

Shape multi-year technology roadmaps supporting platform modernization, scalability, resiliency, and operational excellence.
Influence enterprise architecture, engineering standards, and technology investment decisions.

Engineering Excellence

Drive consistent, predictable, and high-quality software delivery through modern engineering practices, automation, AI-enabled development capabilities, and continuous improvement.
Champion cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps adoption, CI/CD automation, and platform engineering best practices.
Oversee delivery of client- and advisor-facing capabilities through the software development lifecycle within a scaled agile environment.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

Build, develop, and mentor high-performing engineering leaders and teams.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning.
Drive succession planning, leadership development, and organizational effectiveness across the engineering organization.
Create an environment where teams are empowered to solve complex business and technology challenges.

Innovation & Transformation

Lead the adoption and delivery of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and emerging technology capabilities that improve customer and advisor experiences.
Drive platform modernization initiatives leveraging cloud-native, containerized, and event-driven architectures.
Evaluate industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive insights to influence technology strategy and business outcomes.

What you have

Required Qualifications

12+ years of progressive software engineering and technology leadership experience.
5+ years leading engineering managers and large-scale software engineering organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading leaders in complex, matrixed organizations.
Experience supporting Wealth Management, Financial Advisory, Brokerage, Custody, Trust Services, or FinTech businesses.
Proven success delivering enterprise-scale distributed and highly scalable applications.
Experience establishing and executing technology strategy, roadmaps, and engineering transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, site reliability, and software quality engineering.
Ability to guide engineering teams working with technologies such as Java, Spring Framework, APIs, messaging and streaming platforms, relational databases, and cloud-native architectures.
Experience delivering cloud-hosted, containerized, and microservices-based applications.

Strong executive communication, organizational leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Platform Engineering + Tooling
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it’s within reach.

What Will You Do?

The Overview

The Sr. Director, Platform Engineering & Tooling will be the senior leader responsible for shaping and scaling Prolaio’s cloud-native platform engineering capabilities that underpin its clinical, quality, research, and AI-driven data ecosystem. This role owns the foundational tooling (including observability, cloud infrastructure tooling, platform access, data access controls, and data lifecycle management), platform services, and shared engineering capabilities required to support secure, scalable, and governed access to data and platform resources across clinical trials, QMS workflows, clinical research, data science, analytics, and data services in a regulated healthcare environment. This role will ensure that core platform features and services are built with security, privacy, compliance, and auditability by design, and other regulatory expectations relevant to Prolaio’s clinical and patient-data environment. This role will partner with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Quality, Clinical Operations to embed security, privacy, HIPAA and regulatory expectations into every layer of the platform. This is a role for a self-starter and experienced engineering leader who brings both organizational leadership and strong technical credibility in designing, building, and continuously enhancing healthcare data platforms and AI-enabled platform features in a growth-stage company

The Specifics

Lead Prolaio’s platform engineering strategy and roadmap to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable cloud and data platform capabilities aligned to business, clinical, and AI priorities.
Build and evolve the core platform tooling needed for observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cloud operations across GCP-based environments.
Own foundational platform capabilities for platform access, data access, identity-aware controls, service authorization, and secure environment provisioning.
Drive platform services and automation for data lifecycle management, including ingestion, validation, publishing, retention, archival, lineage, traceability, and audit readiness.
Partner with the Director of Data Engineering to strengthen Prolaio’s data architecture, API’s, data pipelines, and warehouse capabilities as part of the broader enterprise data platform.
Deliver reusable platform features and shared services that accelerate clinical research, analytics, data science, and data services teams.
Ensure platform features are designed with security, privacy, compliance, and HIPAA-aligned controls built in from the start, including support for regulated and validated environments.
Lead the development of AI-powered platform capabilities such as intelligent monitoring, workflow automation, metadata enrichment, and policy-aware access enablement.
Partner across Security, Quality, Clinical Operations, Product, and Data teams to embed governance, operational controls, and regulatory readiness into the platform lifecycle.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing platform engineering team with clear ownership, strong execution discipline, and a mindset suited to a fast-moving growth-stage company.

Why Prolaio?

Impactful Work:
You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
Innovative Environment:
You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
Professional Growth:
You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
Collaborative Team:
You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of experience in healthcare, medtech, life sciences, digital health, or another patient-focused environment, with meaningful responsibility for data platforms, platform engineering, or cloud-native enterprise platforms. Minimum 7 years of experience as Sr. Director/VP Engineering or Platform Engineering.
Demonstrated success as a senior engineering leader, including building, scaling, and coaching engineering teams while maintaining strong technical judgment and delivery accountability.
Proven experience designing, developing, and successfully delivering modern data platforms or platform engineering capabilities that support analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and enterprise data use cases.
Strong experience with GCP and cloud-native platform engineering practices, including infrastructure automation, observability, access controls, API-first architectures, and scalable service design.
Strong software engineering experience using Python and at least one of Java or .NET, with familiarity building internal platform features, services, or developer tooling; experience with SQL is required. Experience with Angular or React is good to have.
Deep understanding of the capabilities needed to support clinical trials, QMS ecosystems, clinical research, data science, analytics, and data services in regulated healthcare settings.
Familiarity with metadata, lineage, catalog, governance, and AI-enablement tools, including platforms for semantic indexing, vectorization, retrieval, and data lifecycle automation.
Experience implementing data lifecycle management, governed data access, metadata or lineage-aware architectures, and platform controls that support traceability, reproducibility, auditability, and privacy requirements.
Strong working knowledge of healthcare security, privacy, and compliance expectations, including HIPAA and regulated system practices such as 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP-aligned controls, as they apply to platform engineering and patient-data systems.
Ability to operate as a self-starter in a cross-functional, matrixed, growth-stage environment, partnering effectively with CIO leadership, Engineering, Security, Quality, Clinical Operations, Product, Analytics and Data Science teams.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Meaningful Compensation
: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build.
Great Health Coverage:
Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions.
Flexible Spending Perks:
HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual Lifestyle Spending Account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more.
Time to Recharge:
Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays.
Family-First Benefits
: Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families.
Security & Peace of Mind
: Company-paid life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
Plan for the Future
: 401(k) plan to help you build long-term financial security.
Care When You Need It:
Easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life’s unexpected moments.

Starting Salary is at $239,000.00 (Exact Compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location)

As a Director of Cloud Engineering, you blend deep cloud technical experience with a passion for agile product delivery. This position involves managing a team of developers whose job is to build platforms and composite solutions in support of Fidelity Brokerage Recordkeeping Technology’s cloud transformation. This position involves working on an exceptionally talented team whose job is to build cloud native application platforms and solutions in support of Fidelity’s cloud journey. The ideal candidate for this position will have a strong background in cloud technologies, product development, and experience leading technical teams in an agile fashion. They will be able to navigate and manage technical complexities while developing secure and scalable solutions for our customers.

The Team

The Shared Services Engineering organization is responsible for enabling Fidelity Brokerage Recordkeeping Technology to accelerate the delivery of value to Fidelity’s customers by providing cloud native composite solutions, platforms, frameworks, and security capabilities. You will be a key member of the Shared Services Engineering team who is responsible for building application platforms, composite API’s, tools and frameworks to advance the organization’s ability to leverage the public cloud for solving business problems.

The Expertise You Have

Bachelor's or master's degree with 12 plus years of knowledge and experience working in software and cloud infrastructure engineering with various technology platforms.
Experience managing business priorities and understanding how to make tradeoffs when considering pace over perfection.
Strong Java backend API development & public cloud understanding with AWS.
Experience directing technical teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Assist VP of Engineering in developing and implementing a multi-year technology strategy for BRT Application Solutions aligned with enterprise priorities.
Lead modernization of components of the Application Platforms, Gateways and Composite Solutions from legacy mainframe systems to cloud native architectures.
Leading, influencing, and motivating a team of engineers focused on Cloud Migrations, API Platforms, and other business critical service interface development.
Supporting large scale, mission critical applications that cannot afford any downtime.
Solid leadership skills with the ability to recruit and develop new technical talent.
Expert in building containerized applications using Java Spring Boot and Micronaut.
Experience with Java, Python, Golang, Node JS, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure Code, Helm, Terraform.
Strong communication skills with the ability to present to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience managing products delivered to technical teams.
Preferred experience in retail financial markets or another highly regulated industry.

The Skills You Bring

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with which you build and maintain strong cross-functional partnerships and relationships at all levels of the organization
Intellectually curious and model a culture of continuous learning, mentoring, and coaching
You enjoy helping your team grow and develop into a stronger and more efficient team
You enjoy finding opportunities to innovate and take thoughtful risks to get things done faster
You are truly client-obsessed and dedicated to understanding and learning about customer needs and requirements; both external and internal

Influence strategic backlog and prioritization decisions related to BRT Application Solutions Engineering.
Delivering solutions to BRT development teams and understanding how to support them
Develop a point of view on new and emerging trends to advance solutions that result in efficiencies and faster time to market
Organizing and driving the work for your team in the most efficient manner, delivering the most value to your technical and business partners in Brokerage Recordkeeping Technology.
Actively sharing insights, knowledge, industry practices and developments across the organization

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology & Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
The Director of Information Technology & Artificial Intelligence leads the organization’s technology strategy, operations, and infrastructure while personally driving the design, build, and adoption of artificial intelligence across the enterprise. This role oversees all aspects of information technology, including ERP systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data governance, end-user support, and vendor management. It also serves as the company’s hands-on AI expert and internal leader for AI strategy, governance, and deployment: the person who evaluates the tools, builds the solutions, and makes technology investments translate into measurable efficiency, better decisions, and stronger business performance. This is a working leadership role for someone who builds, not only plans.

Essential Duties:

Information Technology Leadership:

Direct the overall IT function, including enterprise applications, infrastructure, network operations, cybersecurity, technical support, and system administration.
Oversee the SAP environment and supporting reporting technologies, including BW, SAC, EDI, and data integration platforms.
Ensure the reliability, security, and performance of technology systems supporting manufacturing and business operations.
Lead cybersecurity initiatives, user access management, business continuity planning, and disaster recovery programs.
Establish and maintain data governance standards, system controls, and technology policies.
Manage technology vendors, contracts, and service providers to ensure alignment with organizational objectives and budget requirements.
Provide leadership, coaching, and development to the Information Technology team.

Artificial Intelligence Leadership:

Develop and execute the organization’s artificial intelligence strategy and implementation roadmap.
Personally evaluate, design, build, and deploy AI solutions, including large language model applications, automation, machine learning, and integrations into SAP and the company’s reporting environment.
Identify and prioritize AI opportunities across Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, and other business functions.
Lead the deployment and adoption of AI solutions, including rolling out solutions already in development, so they become tools the business actually uses.
Establish governance frameworks addressing AI security, data privacy, vendor selection, risk management, and acceptable use standards.
Promote enterprise-wide AI literacy and adoption through training, education, and change management initiatives.
Measure and communicate the business value of AI initiatives through defined performance metrics and return-on-investment analysis.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
Hands-on experience building and shipping artificial intelligence and automation solutions (large language models, machine learning, data pipelines, RPA) in a business environment, not only directing or purchasing them.
Experience developing and implementing AI governance frameworks and enterprise AI programs.
Progressive leadership experience in Information Technology, including responsibility for ERP systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and enterprise applications.
Experience leading technology transformations, enterprise system implementations, or large-scale digital initiatives.
Strong knowledge of information security, technology governance, and risk management practices.
Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams while collaborating effectively with executive leadership and business stakeholders.
Sound judgment on build-versus-buy decisions, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to a non-technical leadership team.
Experience with SAP, including S/4HANA, BW, SAC, or related technologies.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Background in manufacturing, consumer packaged goods (CPG), distribution, or other operational environments a plus.

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. Join Twitch's Product Core Engineering team and help power the future of our innovative, global platform. As a Sr. Engineering Manager for the Android Platform team, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic vision and execution for Twitch's cutting-edge mobile experiences.

Our mission is to empower engineers to build delightful, secure, and reliable experiences for our passionate communities worldwide. You'll be a key driver of this vision, leading a talented team that delivers the core tools, services, and frameworks that Twitch Builders leverage to innovate on the Android platform. Collaborate cross-functionally to identify new opportunities, align on priorities, and deliver seamless mobile experiences that wow our users. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on the Twitch platform and the millions of creators and communities we serve. If you're a seasoned Android expert with a passion for building game-changing mobile products, we want to hear from you!

You can work from San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; or New York, NY.

You Will:

Craft an inspiring strategic vision for your team and forge impactful partnerships - both with product management and the iOS Platform team - to shape Twitch's cutting-edge mobile platform strategy.
Architect a bold roadmap and deliver transformative software that brings your vision to life.
Increase the rate we launch features for our creators and viewers by providing a first class developer experience.
Drive relentless improvements to our software development processes, metrics, testing, and operational excellence - elevating the team to new heights of efficiency and impact.
Define insightful KPIs to track team progress, delight customers, and advance operational excellence.
Communicate your passion and ideas with eloquence, captivating audiences across the organization.
Foster a collaborative, innovative culture - harmonizing diverse viewpoints and adeptly resolving complex challenges.
Nurture the careers of your talented engineers, empowering them to reach new levels of growth and success.

You Have:

5+ years of professional mobile software development experience.
3+ years as an engineering manager or team lead.
Experience shipping Android apps at scale.
Experience hiring and developing remote engineers under your guidance.
Experience collaborating with product managers, designers and other engineering leaders in cross-functional groups.

Otis Elevator Company is searching for a highly motivated Sr Manager, Service Field Engineering
to provide technical support and guidance to field associates.

Essential Responsibilities

#1. Troubleshooting

On a proactive and emergency basis, assist the OAs / OTs on the malfunctioning of equipment, determine needed corrective action see that it is implemented and advise personnel.
Provide technical direction to branch adjusters and other field personnel

#2. Training

Provide training on all types of equipment.
Candidate will provide guidance at job sites, distribute necessary written information to familiarize field personnel with service, new equipment & mod equipment.
Make regular inspection trips through assigned territory to consult with Service Supervisors, Construction Superintendents, Constructors, Adjusters, and Examiners on problems encountered with product performance.
Assist in designing and delivering field education classes

#3. Continuous Improvement

Have control and responsibility for the quality of all service work, new installations, modernization and monitoring first inspection reports and field test and data reports and resolving service problems, new installation, and modernization.
Utilize the CRC data to resolve problems with the highest callback units in assigned territory.
Consult with engineering personnel on equipment issues, report and suggest constructive changes based upon experience with products in the field.
Determine from patterns of complaints when a problem is repetitive and warrants a change in design or manufacture, seek the solution through the respective organization and see that it is completed within in reasonable time-frame.
Supervising T.I.P. and Re-Work Log systems to keep costs reasonable and realistic.
Assist supervisors and superintendents in selecting candidates for adjusting assignments.
Observe all Otis safety policies and procedures.

#4 Communication

Interacting with Customer at branch level to explain technical problems
Face-2-face, phone, written communication
Ability to influence and help customers through challenging situation

#5 Leadership Capabilities

Good under pressure
Present to a large group
Influence
Professionalism and change management capabilities with customer
Driving accountability for the OT and field force
Travel Requirements: The job will require periodic travel.

Education / Certifications

High school degree required; Bachelor’s degree preferred

5+ years relevant technical elevator experience required
Ability to work in a highly team-oriented and dynamic environment
Candidate must demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively develop expectations and relationships with internal and external customers
Needs to be self-motivated and able to manage many simultaneous projects and responsibilities
Successful candidate should be very comfortable in a technical environment utilizing Microsoft based computer software
Strong leadership skills, goal-orientated, strong time management and organizational skills
Working knowledge of Otis and non-Otis software, as well as preferred experience with current and vintage Otis and non-Otis products

Otis is the world’s largest elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation and service business.  We serve customers in over 200 countries and territories around the world and maintain more than 2 million elevators and escalators globally. Our Gen2® elevator system, energy-saving ReGen™ drive technology and Link escalator solutions have set industry standards for innovation and performance. Otis has more than 68,000 employees, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians.  We are proud to be a global team that continues to rise to the challenges of a fast-moving, high-performance company. Together, the people of Otis are creating new ideas and opportunities by collaborating across time zones, geographies and cultures to better serve our customers. So just imagine where you can take your career!

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge. 

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. jobs.title: Head of Platform Architecture
jobs.description:
At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident.

We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity.

Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you.

Role Summary

At T. Rowe Price, the mission of the Enterprise Architecture (EA) function is to empower the firm to achieve its strategic objectives through the optimal use of technology. The EA function will align technology with business capabilities to enable effective strategy execution and business transformation. By monitoring and adopting emerging technologies, EA will drive technology enabled innovation and keep the firm ahead of industry disruption.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Head of Platforms Architecture to join our team. This role will provide enterprise-level leadership and direction for platform and infrastructure architecture, with accountability for strategy, standards, roadmaps, governance, and operating model alignment across multiple technology domains and teams. The role will lead directly and through senior architects, engineering leaders, and cross-functional partners to deliver scalable, secure, and business-aligned technology platforms. This role will also be playing a lead role in M&A technology due diligence and integration planning, applying platform architecture to accelerate integration and synergy generation. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise architecture, excellent leadership abilities, and a comprehensive understanding of both technical platform ecosystems that accelerate software delivery, and underlying infrastructure design, including but not limited to cloud, networking, compute, storage, and end user computing.

Focus

Oversee enterprise perspective on common enterprise platforms that are leveraged firm-wide to unlock scalability and improved productivity.
Drive for common standards and usage of platforms and infrastructure across the firm while pushing to eliminate legacy redundancy.
Leverage the voice of engineers and software development lifecycle as a guide, to define the future state of technical platforms, which absorbs heaving liftings of solving recurring technical problems into the platform layer, and free up developers to focus on business features.
Focus the future state architecture across public cloud and on premise infrastructure at the conceptual and logical level, and partner closely with platform engineering, and infrastructure teams to translate into physical design.
Design and oversee the operating model for platform and infrastructure architecture across multiple teams, ensuring clear ownership, decision rights, review forums, and lifecycle accountability for enterprise technology platforms.
Spearhead M&A technology due diligence, integration planning, execution of integrating infrastructure and technology landscape between T Rowe Price and target entities.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning and Development:
Develop and maintain the technical platform and infrastructure architecture strategy and roadmap.
Ensure alignment of platform architecture with the organization’s business objectives and IT strategy to increase speed of delivery.
Ensure alignment of infrastructure architecture with the organization’s business growth ambition for scalability and flexibility.
Advise and provide consulting for new technologies to modernize infrastructure capabilities and improve efficiency.

The Vice President, Head of Money Movement engineering is a senior executive within the FIS Technology organization, accountable for leading the product development of money movement, including a wide range of solutions, such as ACH, FedNow, real-time payments, instant payments, retail payments, commercial payments, and cross-border payments. This leader will set technical strategy and direction for money movement, modernize product delivery and architecture, scale product and solution for growth, and ensure high availability, observability, resiliency and recovery. This leader will partner closely with technology, business, product, and operation leaders to build and lead a high-performing organization of engineers and technical leaders.

Technical Leadership

Payments Domain Expertise

Experience navigating card scheme rules, interchange, dispute/chargeback flows, and network compliance
Familiarity with PSPs, issuing/acquiring processors, BaaS partners, and correspondent banking relationships
Working knowledge of PCI-DSS, SOC 1/2, AML/KYC obligations, and how they constrain system design

People & Organization

Recruit, develop, and retain senior/staff/principal engineers and engineering managers
Build a culture of operational excellence, incident ownership, and continuous improvement

Reliability & Operations

Own SLAs for payment success rates, latency, and settlement accuracy — typically 99.99%+ uptime expectations

Build observability and alerting stacks tailored to financial transaction monitoring

Stakeholder & Executive Engagement

Represent the Technology organization in executive forums, steering committees, and board-level reporting on strategic programs

15+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in payments or financial services infrastructure
5+ years leading large engineering organizations (managers of managers)
Demonstrated, specific money movement domain knowledge — candidates without this are screened out at the first round

Track record of delivering complex, multi-year engineering programs on time
Strong communication skills — able to translate technical risk into business impact for C-suite and board audiences
Proven ability to operate at the executive level — directly advising C-suite leaders, presenting to boards, and influencing across functional boundaries
Strong command of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, SAFe, Lean, hybrid) and portfolio management practices and tooling (e.g., Jira Align, Clarity, Planview, ServiceNow SPM)
Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills; able to distill complexity into clear narratives and decisions

Background working with embedded finance or BaaS platforms
Experience managing through a major regulatory audit or remediation (e.g., CFPB, OCC, FinCEN)
Direct experience with cloud transformation (AWS, Azure, GCP), platform modernization, data/AI programs, or core banking/payments platform migrations

Strategic Thinking — Connects technology execution to business outcomes and long-term competitive positioning
Executive Influence — Builds credibility quickly across senior stakeholders; communicates with clarity and conviction
Bias for Outcomes — Drives delivery and benefits realization, not just activity

jobs.title: Director of Corporate Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for supporting and improving the equipment engineering strategy, asset management approach, maintenance efficiency, and overall equipment standards for all business units where Ports America has management control. In business units which Ports America has a minority stake the Director of Engineering will use all reasonable efforts to influence the engineering strategy and standards in line with Ports America established standards. This role will work closely with Maintenance, Procurement, Operations, IT and Legal departments for all equipment-related matters. The position is responsible for supporting and improving safety and environmental standards as well as enforcement within the engineering function in conjunction with the SVP of Health, Safety & Sustainability. The Director of Engineering will work closely to align standards and objectives with all business unit heads.

Essential Duties:

Direct, develop, communicate, and manage the group’s engineering strategies, performance, growth, and development needs to support overall cost and operational objectives as well as stakeholder expectations.
Participate and lead engineering and corporate Management meetings as required and appropriate.
Monitor, collaborate and support the equipment procurement program. Develop, refine, and implement equipment specifications and framework strategies to provide maximum cost benefits and equipment quality to Ports America.
Function as a subject matter expert and business liaison between engineering, procurement, HS&S, and other functions within the organization.
Lead, manage, communicate, and implement Ports America maintenance efficiencies, safety and environmental best practices, process improvements, cost saving initiatives, standardization in line with the group strategy, objectives, and expectations. Research for ‘continual process improvement’ initiatives and the latest technologies to support terminal operations.
Ensure companywide conformance and compliance with established Ports America engineering and corporate policies, procedures, safety & environmental, applicable legislation and regulatory institutions as appropriate, through controlled auditing and mentoring processes.
Support, improve and implementation of the company’s Asset Management program.
Promote and demonstrate positive behaviors in harmony with Ports America’s values and culture.
Ensure that the highest levels of safety are applied in all activities.
Understand and adhere to Ports America Code of Conduct and Ethics policies.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Physical Working Attributes:

Maneuver on a ship, terminal yard, crane, area buildings and terminal equipment. This includes occasional stairs, ladders, height, small spaces, and proximity to rotating equipment, stored energy, deep water and large machines.
Frequent sitting, occasional standing and walking.
Some environments may be hazardous to persons unable to see or hear fast moving heavy equipment.

Minimum Requirements:

Bachelors Degree in Engineering
Combination of education and experience may be considered.

10+ years of Engineering leadership experience that has encompassed any combination of the following:
Major capital equipment projects.
Container terminal engineering function.
Major engineering system implementation experience.
Asset Management development & implementation.
Nationally recognized engineering qualification

Knowledge of the container port industry with respect to all aspects of the engineering functions, cranes, port equipment, automation, maintenance management, computerized maintenance systems and integration of new technologies, methods or standards.
Detailed knowledge of reliability engineering and maintenance planning programs.

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters in Engineering and/or M.B.A
Ability to understand terminal operations, planning, and stevedore operations principles.
Knowledge of the container port industry with respect to all aspects of the engineering functions, cranes, port equipment, automation, computerized maintenance system and technologies, integrated technologies, methods, and standards.
Detailed knowledge of reliability engineering and maintenance planning programs recommended.
Excellent computer literacy.
Experience in stevedoring and marine terminal markets.
Experience with industry-related labor contracts.
Knowledge of safety and accident prevention codes and regulations.
Knowledge of industry-related regulatory codes and requirements.
Experience with profit and loss principles.
Requires the ability to communicate effectively with diverse customers and market base.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The employee may perform other related duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Ports America is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy); sexual orientation; gender identity and/or expression; age; disability; genetic information, citizenship status; military service obligations or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
This is where
your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Advancing Healthcare Through Innovation

At Baxter, we are deeply connected by our mission. Every role at Baxter contributes to improving outcomes for patients around the world. As a Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering, you will play a critical leadership role in driving manufacturing excellence, supporting new product introductions, and helping deliver life-saving medical products with quality, efficiency, and innovation at the center of everything we do.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic and hands-on engineering leader who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and is passionate about leading teams, driving continuous improvement, and enabling operational success.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead and develop a team with varied strengths of manufacturing engineers and technicians, supporting a collaborative, inclusive, and achievement-focused culture.
Provide coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to support team growth and engagement.
Partner with senior leadership to define and implement the engineering roadmap supporting SKF products and manufacturing operations.
Oversee the design, implementation, optimization, and transfer of manufacturing processes for new and existing products.
Improve productivity, reduce waste, enhance product quality, and support operational efficiency initiatives.
Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies to identify and implement sustainable process improvements.
Lead multiple engineering projects that span multi-functional areas from concept through implementation.
Develop project timelines, resource plans, budgets, and risk mitigation strategies to ensure successful execution.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with quality and compliance requirements.
Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and Operations teams to align manufacturing strategies with business objectives.
Serve as a key liaison between Manufacturing Engineering and members of multi-functional teams to support effective communication and project alignment.
Support compliance with FDA, ISO, cGMP, and Baxter quality standards across manufacturing operations.
Conduct process reviews, audits, and performance evaluations to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and compliance enhancement.
Champion a strong culture of quality, safety, and operational excellence..
Manage engineering-related budgets and resource allocation to maximize operational performance and return on investment.
Monitor key performance metrics and communicate project updates, business results, and improvement opportunities to leadership.
Build strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, including suppliers and customers.
Promote Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) compliance and proactively contribute to Baxter’s commitment to zero harm in the workplace.
Stay informed on emerging manufacturing technologies and industry trends to support innovation and best-practice implementation.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering field. Master’s degree experience in Engineering or related field.
8+ years of manufacturing engineering experience, preferably within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or healthcare industry.
Demonstrated success leading engineering teams and managing complex manufacturing or process improvement projects.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing operations, quality systems, and regulated environments.
Knowledge of FDA, ISO, cGMP, and regulated manufacturing environments.
Strong leadership and people development skills
Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities
Excellent communication and partner management skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement mindset
Strong collaboration and multi-functional partnership skills.
PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other project/process improvement certifications.
Experience with CAD software, simulation tools, and manufacturing data analysis.

Work Environment

Combination of office, manufacturing, and laboratory-based work environments.
Regular interaction with cross-functional teams in collaborative settings.
Occasional travel may be required for manufacturing site visits, customer meetings, or industry events.
Use of standard office technology, engineering systems, and manufacturing tools.
Adherence to PPE and safety protocols in manufacturing and laboratory environments.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The salary range for this position is $152,000 - $209,000. Financial and retirement benefits include the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), with the ability to purchase company stock at a discount, and the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (RSP), with options for employee contributions and company matching. We also offer Flexible Spending Accounts, educational assistance programs, and time-off benefits such as paid holidays, paid time off ranging from 20 to 35 days based on length of service, family and medical leaves of absence, and paid parental leave. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. Join us and enjoy the competitive compensation and benefits we offer to our employees. Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. Our mission is to empower engineers to build delightful, secure, and reliable experiences for our passionate communities worldwide. You'll be a key driver of this vision, leading a talented team that delivers the core tools, services, and frameworks that Twitch Builders leverage to innovate on the Android platform. Collaborate cross-functionally to identify new opportunities, align on priorities, and deliver seamless mobile experiences that wow our users. Drive continuous improvement in the quality and performance of our Android apps and champion a culture of innovation that embraces diverse perspectives and moves boldly.

This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on the Twitch platform and the millions of creators and communities we serve. If you're a seasoned Android expert with a passion for building game-changing mobile products, we want to hear from you!

Architect a bold roadmap and deliver transformative software that brings your vision to life.
Increase the rate we launch features for our creators and viewers by providing a first class developer experience.
Drive relentless improvements to our software development processes, metrics, testing, and operational excellence - elevating the team to new heights of efficiency and impact.
Define insightful KPIs to track team progress, delight customers, and advance operational excellence.
Communicate your passion and ideas with eloquence, captivating audiences across the organization.
Foster a collaborative, innovative culture - harmonizing diverse viewpoints and adeptly resolving complex challenges.
Nurture the careers of your talented engineers, empowering them to reach new levels of growth and success.

5+ years of professional mobile software development experience.
3+ years as an engineering manager or team lead.
Experience shipping Android apps at scale.
Experience hiring and developing remote engineers under your guidance.
Experience collaborating with product managers, designers and other engineering leaders in cross-functional groups.

B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related, technical discipline

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Data Engineering + Integrations
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it’s within reach.

What Will You Do?

The Overview

The Director/Sr. Director, Data Engineering will lead and scale Prolaio’s healthcare data engineering capabilities that power its clinical intelligence products, real-world data pipelines, analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and data services in a regulated environment, building secure, reliable, and AI-enabled data platforms that transform continuous, predictive, and shareable heart data into faster therapeutic discovery and better cardiovascular outcomes while operating as a self-starter senior leader in a growth-stage company. This role will ensure that core data engineering features and services are built with security, privacy, compliance, and auditability by design, and other regulatory expectations relevant to Prolaio’s clinical and patient-data environment. This role will partner with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Quality, Clinical Operations to embed security, privacy, HIPAA and regulatory expectations into every layer of the data engineering features. This is a role for a self-starter and experienced engineering leader who brings both organizational leadership and strong technical credibility in designing, building, and continuously enhancing data engineering and AI-enabled data pipeline features in a growth-stage company.

The Specifics

Lead Prolaio’s enterprise data engineering strategy and roadmap to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable data platform capabilities aligned to clinical, research, product, and AI priorities in regulated healthcare settings.
Architect and oversee end-to-end data flows and reusable pipelines for ingestion, validation, transformation, enrichment, publishing, retention, archival, and decommissioning across batch, streaming, and hybrid workloads.
Own the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and interoperable data platforms that support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured clinical, operational, device, and patient-generated data relevant to Prolaio’s cardiovascular mission.
Define and enforce engineering standards for data modeling, lifecycle management, lineage, provenance, traceability, and auditability, embedding HIPAA, privacy, security, and GxP-aligned practices into day-to-day development workflows.
Partner closely with Data Architecture to design and govern conceptual, logical, and physical data models, apply healthcare standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OMOP, CDISC), and deliver analysis-ready, interoperable datasets.
Build and evolve robust data engineering capabilities across modern cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure) and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse), including orchestration, metadata, APIs, and integration patterns.
Lead the development of AI-enabled data engineering features such as intelligent data quality monitoring, metadata enrichment, semantic search, feature generation workflows, and automation that accelerate analytics, data science, and clinical research teams.
Collaborate with Quality, Clinical Operations, Security, Product, and Engineering to embed validation, change management, governed data access, master data management, and release readiness into the data platform lifecycle.
Establish and manage high-performing data engineering teams, providing clear ownership, coaching, and execution discipline suited to a fast-moving growth-stage environment, while influencing architecture and implementation decisions across a matrixed organization.
Support vendor and tool evaluation, including build-versus-buy decisions for data integration, quality, metadata, lineage, interoperability, and AI-enabled data management capabilities.

Why Prolaio?

Impactful Work:
You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
Innovative Environment:
You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
Professional Growth:
You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
Collaborative Team:
You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of experience in healthcare, medtech, life sciences, digital health, or another patient-focused environment, with meaningful responsibility for data platforms, platform engineering, or cloud-native enterprise platforms.
At least 7 years of experience as a Director or Sr. Director (or equivalent senior leadership role) leading data engineering or closely related data platform teams in growth-stage or innovation-driven organizations.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering healthcare data platforms that support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, with proven success in regulated or validated environments.
Deep understanding of healthcare data domains (clinical trials, cardiovascular and physiological data, real-world data, claims, medication, socio-economic and behavioral data) and the application of healthcare terminologies and common data models (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OMOP, CDISC).
Proven experience designing and operating end-to-end data flows, scalable pipelines, lineage, provenance, traceability, and data lifecycle management that support product, analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and data services use cases.
Strong familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, or comparable environments, including hands-on work with orchestration, APIs, and integration.
Strong software engineering and data engineering experience with Python and SQL and at least one of Java or .NET, with a track record of building internal data platform features, services, and developer tooling; experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular or React) is good to have. Experience in developing Agentic pipelines would be a plus.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional, matrixed organizations, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Clinical Operations, Quality, and Security, with a self-starter mindset and comfort with ambiguity in a growth-stage environment.
Familiarity with metadata, lineage, catalog, governance, and AI-enablement tools, including platforms for semantic indexing, vectorization, retrieval, and data lifecycle automation, and experience implementing governed data access and privacy-aware architectures.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Meaningful Compensation
: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build.
Great Health Coverage:
Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions.
Flexible Spending Perks:
HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual Lifestyle Spending Account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more.
Time to Recharge:
Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays.
Family-First Benefits
: Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families.
Security & Peace of Mind
: Company-paid life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
Plan for the Future
: 401(k) plan to help you build long-term financial security.
Care When You Need It:
Easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life’s unexpected moments.

La Rabida Children’s Hospital provides specialized, family-centered health care to children with medically complex conditions, disabilities, and chronic illness. Through expertise, compassion, and advocacy we help children and their families reach their fullest potential, regardless of their ability to pay.

Our not-for-profit hospital, licensed for 49 beds, helps transition children from neonatal or pediatric intensive care to home, by providing medical, rehabilitative and developmental care, and by training families to continue treatments and manage the necessary equipment in the home. La Rabida also provides extensive rehabilitation for those recovering from wounds or burns and treatment for exacerbations of chronic conditions.

The hospital’s enhanced pediatric patient-centered medical home provides primary care to children with complex medical conditions and their siblings. Children with medical homes elsewhere come to La Rabida for specialty services. La Rabida offers a wide range of specialty services provided to children with sickle cell disease, diabetes, and many others. Children are supported in their emotional and developmental growth, particularly in cases where such growth has been interrupted by accident or disease.

Finally, La Rabida provides forensic and treatment services for children exposed to abuse and neglect, comprehensive assessments for youth in care, early intervention for children between 0 and 3 years of age. Care coordination services for medically complex children are also provided for those who are covered by a health plan and receive care from providers in Cook County

Job Description

SUMMARY:
The Director of Physical and Digital Infrastructure provides strategic leadership and operational

oversight for the hospital's Information Technology, Plant Operations, and Security department. Reporting to the Chief Operating & Information Officer, this position directly supervises the Manager of Information Technology, Manager of Plant Operations, and Manager of Security.The Director develops and implements enterprise strategies for technology, cybersecurity, facilities, physical security, environmental safety, and emergency preparedness. This role ensures reliable operations, regulatory compliance, business continuity, and a safe, secure environment that supports high-quality patient care and the hospital's strategic objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Information Technology Leadership

• Develop and execute the hospital's information technology strategy.

• Oversee all IT operations, including networks, servers, telecommunications, cloud services, and end-user

support.

• Ensure high availability and performance of critical clinical and business systems, including Electronic

Health Records (EHR).

• Lead technology planning, budgeting, procurement, and vendor management.

• Manage IT projects, system upgrades, and technology implementations.

• Establish and maintain IT governance, policies, and standards.

• Provide leadership for disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

• Direct the hospital's cybersecurity and information security programs.

• Develop policies and controls to protect patient information and organizational data.

• Ensure compliance with HIPAA, HITECH, Joint Commission standards, and applicable regulatory

requirements.

• Conduct risk assessments, vulnerability management, and incident response activities.

• Monitor security threats and coordinate response efforts.

• Lead security awareness and training initiatives for staff.

• Oversee cybersecurity technologies, including firewalls, endpoint protection, identity management, and

security monitoring solutions.

Plant Operations

• Ensures compliance with safety, infection control, hazardous materials, and emergency management
