jobs.title: Senior Manager – Real Estate Technology Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Overview

When you join Hines, you will embark on a career journey fueled by vision and guided by leaders who set the standards of our industry. Our legacy is rooted in innovation and excellence, earning us a spot on Fast Company’s esteemed annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, as well as recognition as one of U.S. News & World Report’s Best Companies to Work For in 2024. Discover endless opportunities to grow and make your mark at Hines.

Responsibilities

Hybrid position requiring at least three days per week in-office in downtown Houston

Leveraging an AI-first approach, the Senior Manager - Real Estate Technology Infrastructure will be a bridge between our global company vision and the physical technology deployed across our international portfolio. You will ensure that our buildings are "smart by design" by managing the vendor ecosystem, establishing technical standards, and contributing the delivery of complex strategic projects. Your focus will be on the Operational Technology (OT) stack, building the processes and partnerships to ensure our buildings are secure, integrated, and future-ready. In this individual contributor position, you provide strategic ownership of the design, validation, and enforcement of building network and infrastructure standards across our property portfolio. The position balances architectural standards, delivery governance, and escalation ownership to ensure infrastructure platforms are secure, resilient, and aligned with business needs. This role reports to the Managing Director, Real Estate Technology Infrastructure.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Strategic Sourcing: Identify, vet, and manage global and regional vendors for building automation, networking, security systems, and related.
Performance Gover nance: Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for third-party service providers.
Contract Management: Partner with Strategic Sourcing to negotiate enterprise-wide agreements that leverage our 25-country+ scale to drive cost efficiencies. Evaluate vendor proposals, quotes, licensing models, and support options; develop comparison materials and provide cost-risk tradeoff analysis to support leadership decision-making. Develop and maintain infrastructure standards for building networks, cybersecurity, and integrated systems to ensure consistency across all regions.
Standardization: Create technical design guidelines that architects and general contractors must follow during the development or retrofit phase. Own the design, validation, and enforcement of building network and infrastructure standards for property environments, including wireless, switching, firewalls, and site connectivity. Incorporate security and risk considerations into infrastructure architecture decisions, including firewall design, redundancy models, failover strategies, and secure remote administration.
Cross-Functional Liaison: Act as a technical lead between Technology, Management Services, Engineering, and Construction teams. Maintain portfolio-level visibility of infrastructure deployments, site readiness, remediation efforts, and transition status using enterprise service and project management tools. Ensure complete and accurate documentation, inventories, and configuration records are maintained to support audits, investigations, incident response, and ongoing operations. Support infrastructure requirements for physical security systems, building automation systems, and other safety-critical environments.
Cybersecurity: Securing "connected" building assets, implementing network segmentation, and managing vulnerability patching for hardware. Security Control Systems: Standards for IP-CCTV, cloud-based Access Control, and visitor management systems. Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
You will contribute to oversight and governance across the following critical OT areas: Building Integration & Automation: BMS/BAS, lighting controls, and IoT sensor integration via protocols like BACnet, Modbus, and MQTT. Networking & Communications: Building LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi 6/7, 5G in-building solutions, and unified communications.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements include:

Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited institution preferred or equivalent years of direct experience required.
Professional Experience: 10–12 years of experience in OT infrastructure, specifically within the real estate or construction sectors.
Global Mindset: Proven track record of managing projects or vendors across multiple time zones and regulatory environments.
Practical experience leveraging AI tooling to realize insight and efficiency.
Significant experience in operational infrastructure, network architecture, or technology operations supporting distributed environments.
Demonstrated experience designing and supporting enterprise network and wireless architectures, including firewalls, VPNs, redundancy, and failover models.
Experience supporting construction projects, property portfolios, or multi-site environments with active renovations and transitions preferred.
Strong working knowledge of vendor and ISP coordination, technical oversight, and commercial evaluation.
Project Management: Proficiency with tools like Procore, Bluebeam Revu, Jira, or Smartsheet is a plus.
Technical Literacy: Deep understanding of how physical building systems (HVAC, elevators, utility meters) intersect with digital networks.
Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
Ability and willingness to provide hands-on technical support when required while maintaining strong ownership, accountability, and communication practices.
Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced, and high-pressure environments with cross-functional stakeholders.
Willingness to provide occasional after-hours support for escalations or critical activities and to travel periodically in support of key projects or sites.
Strong working knowledge of OT/IT networking inc. converged networks, and typical connected building systems (i.e., BAS, BMS, ACS, CCTV).
Base competency of modern building systems & “smart” infrastructure.
Strong working knowledge of wireless technologies (i.e., DAS, managed Wi-Fi) preferred.
Strong working knowledge of OT/IT cybersecurity frameworks, principles, and strategies.
Network/communications certifications (i.e., CCNP, CCIE, CWNA) preferred.
Strong cross-functional leadership and project management/stakeholder management.
Proficiency with tools like Procore, Bluebeam Revu, Jira, or Smartsheet is a plus.
Most duties shall be performed in an office setting at Hines’ HQ office in Houston.
The nature of this role will require occasional work outside of Houston business hours to support escalations or critical activities in other regions..
Domestic and international travel will be required periodically (less than 10% of the time) in support of key projects or sites. Travel assignments to certain sites may include requirements to wear provided personal protective equipment (PPE) and may include activities performed in a non-office environment, including outdoors.

Closing

At Hines, we strive for excellence as a leading global real estate investment manager, driven by our by our belief that real estate is fundamentally about people. Our diverse portfolio spans $93.2 billion¹ of assets across such property types as living, office, retail, mixed-use, logistics and life science projects – all designed to enhance value, connection and inspiration. Our strategic approach integrates local expertise with global knowledge, taking calculated risks aligned with our convictions to exceed expectations and tailor solutions to our clients' needs.

While our projects are renowned for enhancing cities and pioneering sustainable practices, we recognize that the true driving force behind Hines' success is our 5,000 dedicated employees in 30 countries who draw on our 65-year history to build the world forward. This is why we prioritize investing in our people, offering comprehensive training, competitive compensation, robust benefits and generous vacation packages. By centering our focus on the growth and wellbeing of our team, we cultivate an inclusive environment where everyone, including our clients, can thrive.

Hines is proud to be named to Fast Company’s prestigious annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2024. ¹Includes both the global Hines organization and RIA AUM as of December 31, 2023.

We are an equal opportunity employer and support workforce diversity.

No calls or emails from third parties at this time please.

jobs.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

The Senior Manager, Software Engineering
leads a high impact pillar within the Legal & Privacy engineering organization, responsible for engineering the systems, platforms, and controls that enable the company to operate in compliance with global regulatory requirements and pro-actively managing enterprise risk. This leader is responsible for translating complex regulatory obligations into scalable, resilient, and engineering solutions enabling NBCUniversal.

This role requires both deep technical and senior leadership with business acumen in the compliance and risk space. This leader will own the end-to-end delivery of compliance and risk technical solutions that enable capabilities across jurisdictions, partners directly with Legal, Cyber, and Compliance/Risk Product and Operations. This role will be responsible for hiring, retaining, and continuously assessing the health and growth of the compliance and risk engineering team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Engineering Leadership & Delivery
Leads a team of software and quality engineers delivering compliance automation, AI solutions, risk controls, and regulatory technology platforms
Owns the engineering roadmap for the compliance and risk pillar while balancing regulatory urgency, technical sustainability, and product prioritization
Establish and uphold software quality, legal & privacy architecture and engineering standards, and NBCU cyber guidelines
Drive delivery across multiple complex concurrent programs/projects
Partner with Principal architect, scrum lead, product owner, and technical project manager to ensure standards and stakeholder visibility

Compliance and Regulatory
Translate regulatory requirements (eg. GDPR and CCPA) into technical a deliverable plan
Oversee platforms, automation, and AI solutions enabling the following business capabilities: Ethics & Compliance Enablement, Controls Engineering & Validation, Compliance Driven Vulnerability Discovery, Regulatory Compliance Automation, Risk Management Tooling, GRC Platform Operations, AI / ML Governance and Controls

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
Serve as the senior technical voice for compliance and risk engineering
Communicate program status, risk exposure, and engineering trade-offs to SVPs, VPs and Directors in a clear and business relevant terms
Represent the organization in regulatory discussions, 3rd party audits, and external partner engagements as needed

System Reliability & Performance:
Proactively manage reliability and performance of all Compliance and Risks systems to ensure they meet global business needs. Partner closely with SaaS providers and internal teams to maintain system health and performance.
Defect & Enhancement Management:
Manage the defect management process from identification to resolution. Manage the delivery of enhancements that improve user experience and system efficiency.
Problem & Incident Management:
Own the problem management process, conducting root cause analysis to reduce the number of recurring incidents. Focus on implementing minor enhancements or process changes to prevent future issues. Manage the end-to-end response to major incidents impacting Compliance and Risk business processes. Manage RCA sessions and ensure timely executive – level communications. Reduce “noise” in the system by analyzing ticket trends and automating routine fixes.
Support Standards & SLAs:
Enforce global support standards and best practices including adherence to SLAs for all support activities. Monitor and report on performance metrics (e.g. MTTR, backlog aging) and use data to drive continuous improvements.
Data Integration:
Manage the support and maintenance of data integrations between Compliance & Risk applications and other enterprise systems, leveraging middleware technologies.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in software engineering with 4+ years in engineering management or senior technical leadership
5+ years of experience leading ML and automation solutions
3+ years of experience in deploying AI solutions
Demonstrated experience delivering compliance, regulatory, risk, or governance technology in a large enterprise environment
Working knowledge of major privacy and compliance frameworks (GDPR, CCPA)
Strong track record of leading cross-functional programs with legal, privacy, and compliance stakeholders
Proven ability to influence and communicate at S/VP levels
Experience managing and growing engineering teams (software and quality engineers + managers) in a matrixed Fortune 100 or equivalent environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with data governance platforms or GRC
Familiarity with AI/ML, emerging regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF)
Experience supporting regulatory privacy or security certification
Experience with ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow and Jira)

Fully Remote: 
This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $140,000 - $200,000  (bonus eligible)

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access nbcunicareers.com as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by emailing AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

For LA County and City Residents Only: NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

jobs.title: Product Management Director - Deployment Platform
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

We are seeking a Director-level Individual Contributor in Product Management to lead the strategy, development, and execution of our deployment and operational platform for Connetic, the next generation payment innovation from ACI Worldwide.

This role blends product leadership, DevOps strategy, and cloud-first deployment expertise, with responsibility for enabling secure, scalable, cloud-native and hybrid deployments across on-premises, private cloud, and SaaS environments.

You will define how mission-critical payment software is delivered, deployed, upgraded, and operated globally, across multi-cloud and enterprise environments, working across engineering, global markets, SRE, and customer-facing teams. This is a hands-on strategic role requiring deep technical fluency in cloud platforms, distributed systems, and deployment automation, and the ability to influence without direct authority.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership
Drive the product definition, roadmap, and solution plans for deployment platforms, cloud infrastructure capabilities, and operational tooling.
Develop and maintain multi-year (3–5 year) product strategy and annual operating plans for DevOps, cloud deployment, and platform capabilities.
Define business cases and investment priorities based on market analysis, cloud adoption trends, and customer needs across SaaS and self-managed environments.

DevOps, Cloud & Platform
Own product vision for DevOps and cloud-enabled deployment tooling, including:
Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and GitOps models
CI/CD pipelines and release orchestration across environments
Environment provisioning across multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-prem
Configuration management and secrets management
Observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting)
Define standards for cloud-native architectures, including containerization (Kubernetes), service mesh, and microservices deployment patterns.
Establish automation frameworks to enable consistent, repeatable deployments across SaaS, hybrid, and on-prem environments.
Drive improvements in deployment velocity, reliability, cost efficiency, and operational resilience.

On-Prem, SaaS & Cloud Deployment Strategy
Define and deliver deployment models supporting:
Cloud-native SaaS platforms (multi-tenant and single-tenant)
Hybrid and multi-cloud deployments
Private cloud and on-premise (including air-gapped environments)
Design for portability across cloud providers and customer-managed infrastructure.
Own versioning, upgrade strategies, patching, blue/green and canary releases, and backward compatibility across environments.
Ensure architectures support:
High availability and fault tolerance
Disaster recovery and geo-redundancy
Elastic scalability and workload isolation in cloud environments
Ensure deployment and cloud architecture supports high-performance payment processing, including:
Wires, real-time payments, cards, and ACH
Low latency and high throughput requirements
Regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, regional compliance, data residency)
End-to-end encryption and secure key management
Partner with professional services, solution consulting, application, and payment product teams to ensure seamless delivery across all deployment models.

Customer & Market Engagement
Engage directly with enterprise customers, partners, and implementation teams to understand deployment, cloud adoption, and operational challenges.
Translate customer feedback, cloud migration needs, and market trends into actionable product capabilities.
Partner with Sales and Marketing on go-to-market strategy, including positioning cloud vs on-prem offerings, sales enablement, and customer adoption strategies.

Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate with:
Engineering (platform, cloud infrastructure, and application teams)
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Security, Compliance, and Risk
Professional Services / Implementation
Influence architecture decisions to ensure deployability, operability, scalability, and cloud readiness are core design principles.
Act as a key bridge between platform engineering and customer-facing delivery teams.

Operational & Financial Accountability
Define and track key KPIs:
Deployment success rate
Release frequency and cycle time
Environment provisioning time
Cloud infrastructure utilization and efficiency
Drive continuous improvement through automation, telemetry, and data-driven insights.
Contribute to cost optimization strategies, particularly in cloud infrastructure and SaaS operations.
Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in Product Management, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related roles.
Proven experience managing enterprise software deployments across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem environments.
Strong knowledge of:
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is seeking a visionary Senior Director of Product Strategy to join our Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a rare opportunity to sit at the intersection of product vision, market intelligence, and technical architecture — helping define not just what Salesforce builds next, but why and how.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Product Strategy, you will serve as a key architect of our forward-looking product innovation agenda. You will lead and grow a team of product strategists charged with identifying emerging white spaces, evaluating build-buy-partner options, and translating complex technical and market dynamics into clear, executable product strategies.

This role goes well beyond traditional corporate strategy. We are not looking for someone who reacts to the latest headlines or incoming M&A signals. We are building a team that gets ahead of trends — a group that proactively surfaces what Salesforce might be missing, stress-tests assumptions, and shapes the decisions that will define our product platform for the next decade.

From guiding the productization of emerging internal capabilities — spanning trust infrastructure, workflow automation, and agentic AI architectures — to framing investment theses around high-growth sectors like supply chain agentification, developer tooling, and AI-native systems of record, you will ensure Salesforce is building the right things, at the right time, with the right model.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Drive product strategy for emerging offerings moving from internal capability to standalone or platform-integrated product — including trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI systems, and data platforms.
Own and evolve a strategic framework for evaluating build-buy-partner decisions, including how and when to integrate acquired technologies into the core Salesforce platform versus taking them to market independently.
Proactively identify and assess game-changing market shifts — including the agentic coding revolution, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open source commercialization trends — and translate these into actionable investment recommendations.
Partner closely with the SVP to define 'what are we missing' across the product portfolio, filling gaps in strategic coverage that go beyond what reactive competitive intelligence can provide.
Synthesize inputs from engineering, product management, research, M&A, and external sources to develop clear, evidence-based points of view on where Salesforce should place strategic bets.
Perform quantitative and competitive analytics to size market opportunities, assess competitive positioning, and support investment recommendations with data-driven evidence.
Partner with regional leadership to expand Salesforce's product strategy footprint into European markets, accounting for local regulatory requirements, competitive dynamics, and go-to-market nuances.
Evaluate productization models — open source, platform-bundled, standalone SaaS, API-first — and build decision-making frameworks that account for monetization, competitive dynamics, and developer adoption.
Monitor venture investment trends, startup ecosystem signals, and technical research to stay ahead of emerging paradigms before they become conventional wisdom.
Present strategic recommendations and options to the SVP and cross-functional executives in a clear, structured, and data-supported manner.
Build and mentor a high-performing strategy team, establishing processes for ongoing horizon scanning, opportunity assessment, and strategic synthesis.

You're Our Person If

12+ years of experience spanning product management, product strategy, technology strategy, or innovation roles — preferably at an enterprise software or cloud platform company.
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams of 3 or more strategists, researchers, or product managers in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Deep working knowledge of AI and machine learning architectures, including agentic systems, LLM-based applications, and AI integration patterns within enterprise platforms.
Strong understanding of systems of record, data platforms, and enterprise application architectures, including how AI layers are introduced into or layered atop traditional SaaS infrastructure.
Fluency in evaluating productization strategies, including trade-offs between open source, proprietary, platform-native, and standalone go-to-market models.
Experience participating in or supporting M&A strategy, including acquisition thesis development, integration planning, or build-buy-partner evaluation.
Ability to structure and communicate complex, multi-variable strategic analyses for senior executive audiences — in writing, in presentations, and in live discussions.
Comfort operating in contexts where the problem is not fully defined and the path forward requires both intellectual rigor and creative hypothesis generation.

Even Better If

Experience in product strategy or innovation roles at an AI-first company, an enterprise platform vendor, or a technology-focused management consulting firm.
Familiarity with agentic coding tools, developer platform ecosystems, and the competitive landscape around AI-assisted software development.
Knowledge of supply chain, operations, or vertical AI automation and process agentification at enterprise scale.
Track record of developing original investment or product theses — not simply synthesizing others' frameworks, but originating new points of view.
Exposure to venture capital, corporate development, or startup ecosystem dynamics, with the ability to translate investment signals into product strategy implications.
Builder's mindset: You are energized by creating new things — teams, frameworks, markets — not just running existing processes.
Experience working on both offensive (new market entry, new product launch) and defensive (competitive response, retention of strategic position) product strategies.
MBA, MS, or equivalent advanced degree in a relevant discipline is a plus; demonstrated outcomes matter more than credentials

LI-Y*

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Director, Platform Engineering + Tooling
new_jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it’s within reach.

What Will You Do?

The Overview

The Sr. Director, Platform Engineering & Tooling will be the senior leader responsible for shaping and scaling Prolaio’s cloud-native platform engineering capabilities that underpin its clinical, quality, research, and AI-driven data ecosystem. This role owns the foundational tooling (including observability, cloud infrastructure tooling, platform access, data access controls, and data lifecycle management), platform services, and shared engineering capabilities required to support secure, scalable, and governed access to data and platform resources across clinical trials, QMS workflows, clinical research, data science, analytics, and data services in a regulated healthcare environment. This role will ensure that core platform features and services are built with security, privacy, compliance, and auditability by design, and other regulatory expectations relevant to Prolaio’s clinical and patient-data environment. This role will partner with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Quality, Clinical Operations to embed security, privacy, HIPAA and regulatory expectations into every layer of the platform. This is a role for a self-starter and experienced engineering leader who brings both organizational leadership and strong technical credibility in designing, building, and continuously enhancing healthcare data platforms and AI-enabled platform features in a growth-stage company

The Specifics

Lead Prolaio’s platform engineering strategy and roadmap to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable cloud and data platform capabilities aligned to business, clinical, and AI priorities.
Build and evolve the core platform tooling needed for observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cloud operations across GCP-based environments.
Own foundational platform capabilities for platform access, data access, identity-aware controls, service authorization, and secure environment provisioning.
Drive platform services and automation for data lifecycle management, including ingestion, validation, publishing, retention, archival, lineage, traceability, and audit readiness.
Partner with the Director of Data Engineering to strengthen Prolaio’s data architecture, API’s, data pipelines, and warehouse capabilities as part of the broader enterprise data platform.
Deliver reusable platform features and shared services that accelerate clinical research, analytics, data science, and data services teams.
Ensure platform features are designed with security, privacy, compliance, and HIPAA-aligned controls built in from the start, including support for regulated and validated environments.
Lead the development of AI-powered platform capabilities such as intelligent monitoring, workflow automation, metadata enrichment, and policy-aware access enablement.
Partner across Security, Quality, Clinical Operations, Product, and Data teams to embed governance, operational controls, and regulatory readiness into the platform lifecycle.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing platform engineering team with clear ownership, strong execution discipline, and a mindset suited to a fast-moving growth-stage company.

Why Prolaio?

Impactful Work:
You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
Innovative Environment:
You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
Professional Growth:
You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
Collaborative Team:
You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of experience in healthcare, medtech, life sciences, digital health, or another patient-focused environment, with meaningful responsibility for data platforms, platform engineering, or cloud-native enterprise platforms. Minimum 7 years of experience as Sr. Director/VP Engineering or Platform Engineering.
Demonstrated success as a senior engineering leader, including building, scaling, and coaching engineering teams while maintaining strong technical judgment and delivery accountability.
Proven experience designing, developing, and successfully delivering modern data platforms or platform engineering capabilities that support analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and enterprise data use cases.
Strong experience with GCP and cloud-native platform engineering practices, including infrastructure automation, observability, access controls, API-first architectures, and scalable service design.
Strong software engineering experience using Python and at least one of Java or .NET, with familiarity building internal platform features, services, or developer tooling; experience with SQL is required. Experience with Angular or React is good to have.
Deep understanding of the capabilities needed to support clinical trials, QMS ecosystems, clinical research, data science, analytics, and data services in regulated healthcare settings.
Familiarity with metadata, lineage, catalog, governance, and AI-enablement tools, including platforms for semantic indexing, vectorization, retrieval, and data lifecycle automation.
Experience implementing data lifecycle management, governed data access, metadata or lineage-aware architectures, and platform controls that support traceability, reproducibility, auditability, and privacy requirements.
Strong working knowledge of healthcare security, privacy, and compliance expectations, including HIPAA and regulated system practices such as 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP-aligned controls, as they apply to platform engineering and patient-data systems.
Ability to operate as a self-starter in a cross-functional, matrixed, growth-stage environment, partnering effectively with CIO leadership, Engineering, Security, Quality, Clinical Operations, Product, Analytics and Data Science teams.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Meaningful Compensation
: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build.
Great Health Coverage:
Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions.
Flexible Spending Perks:
HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual Lifestyle Spending Account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more.
Time to Recharge:
Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays.
Family-First Benefits
: Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families.
Security & Peace of Mind
: Company-paid life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
Plan for the Future
: 401(k) plan to help you build long-term financial security.
Care When You Need It:
Easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life’s unexpected moments.

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on the Twitch platform and the millions of creators and communities we serve. If you're a seasoned Android expert with a passion for building game-changing mobile products, we want to hear from you!

You Will:

Craft an inspiring strategic vision for your team and forge impactful partnerships - both with product management and the iOS Platform team - to shape Twitch's cutting-edge mobile platform strategy.
Architect a bold roadmap and deliver transformative software that brings your vision to life.
Increase the rate we launch features for our creators and viewers by providing a first class developer experience.
Drive relentless improvements to our software development processes, metrics, testing, and operational excellence - elevating the team to new heights of efficiency and impact.
Define insightful KPIs to track team progress, delight customers, and advance operational excellence.
Communicate your passion and ideas with eloquence, captivating audiences across the organization.
Foster a collaborative, innovative culture - harmonizing diverse viewpoints and adeptly resolving complex challenges.
Nurture the careers of your talented engineers, empowering them to reach new levels of growth and success.

You Have:

5+ years of professional mobile software development experience.
3+ years as an engineering manager or team lead.
Experience shipping Android apps at scale.
Experience hiring and developing remote engineers under your guidance.
Experience collaborating with product managers, designers and other engineering leaders in cross-functional groups.

Familiarity with react-native or equivalent mobile web technology
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related, technical discipline

new_jobs.description:

2026-06-05

Country:

United States of America

Location:

Otis Elevator Company is searching for a highly motivated Sr Manager, Service Field Engineering
to provide technical support and guidance to field associates.

Essential Responsibilities

#1. Troubleshooting

On a proactive and emergency basis, assist the OAs / OTs on the malfunctioning of equipment, determine needed corrective action see that it is implemented and advise personnel.
Provide technical direction to branch adjusters and other field personnel

#2. Training

Provide training on all types of equipment.
Candidate will provide guidance at job sites, distribute necessary written information to familiarize field personnel with service, new equipment & mod equipment.
Make regular inspection trips through assigned territory to consult with Service Supervisors, Construction Superintendents, Constructors, Adjusters, and Examiners on problems encountered with product performance.
Assist in designing and delivering field education classes

#3. Continuous Improvement

Have control and responsibility for the quality of all service work, new installations, modernization and monitoring first inspection reports and field test and data reports and resolving service problems, new installation, and modernization.
Utilize the CRC data to resolve problems with the highest callback units in assigned territory.
Consult with engineering personnel on equipment issues, report and suggest constructive changes based upon experience with products in the field.
Determine from patterns of complaints when a problem is repetitive and warrants a change in design or manufacture, seek the solution through the respective organization and see that it is completed within in reasonable time-frame.
Supervising T.I.P. and Re-Work Log systems to keep costs reasonable and realistic.
Assist supervisors and superintendents in selecting candidates for adjusting assignments.
Observe all Otis safety policies and procedures.

#4 Communication

Interacting with Customer at branch level to explain technical problems
Face-2-face, phone, written communication
Ability to influence and help customers through challenging situation

#5 Leadership Capabilities

Good under pressure
Present to a large group
Influence
Professionalism and change management capabilities with customer
Driving accountability for the OT and field force
Travel Requirements: The job will require periodic travel.

Education / Certifications

High school degree required; Bachelor’s degree preferred

Basic Qualifications

5+ years relevant technical elevator experience required
Ability to work in a highly team-oriented and dynamic environment
Candidate must demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively develop expectations and relationships with internal and external customers
Needs to be self-motivated and able to manage many simultaneous projects and responsibilities
Successful candidate should be very comfortable in a technical environment utilizing Microsoft based computer software
Strong leadership skills, goal-orientated, strong time management and organizational skills
Working knowledge of Otis and non-Otis software, as well as preferred experience with current and vintage Otis and non-Otis products

Otis is the world’s largest elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation and service business.  We serve customers in over 200 countries and territories around the world and maintain more than 2 million elevators and escalators globally. Our Gen2® elevator system, energy-saving ReGen™ drive technology and Link escalator solutions have set industry standards for innovation and performance. Otis has more than 68,000 employees, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians.  We are proud to be a global team that continues to rise to the challenges of a fast-moving, high-performance company. Together, the people of Otis are creating new ideas and opportunities by collaborating across time zones, geographies and cultures to better serve our customers. So just imagine where you can take your career!

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge. 

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. Become a part of the Otis team and help us #Buildwhatsnext!

new_jobs.title: Head of Platform Architecture
new_jobs.description:
At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident.

We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity.

Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you.

Role Summary

At T. Rowe Price, the mission of the Enterprise Architecture (EA) function is to empower the firm to achieve its strategic objectives through the optimal use of technology. The EA function will align technology with business capabilities to enable effective strategy execution and business transformation. By monitoring and adopting emerging technologies, EA will drive technology enabled innovation and keep the firm ahead of industry disruption.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Head of Platforms Architecture to join our team. This role will provide enterprise-level leadership and direction for platform and infrastructure architecture, with accountability for strategy, standards, roadmaps, governance, and operating model alignment across multiple technology domains and teams. The role will lead directly and through senior architects, engineering leaders, and cross-functional partners to deliver scalable, secure, and business-aligned technology platforms. This role will also be playing a lead role in M&A technology due diligence and integration planning, applying platform architecture to accelerate integration and synergy generation. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise architecture, excellent leadership abilities, and a comprehensive understanding of both technical platform ecosystems that accelerate software delivery, and underlying infrastructure design, including but not limited to cloud, networking, compute, storage, and end user computing.

Focus

Oversee enterprise perspective on common enterprise platforms that are leveraged firm-wide to unlock scalability and improved productivity.
Drive for common standards and usage of platforms and infrastructure across the firm while pushing to eliminate legacy redundancy.
Leverage the voice of engineers and software development lifecycle as a guide, to define the future state of technical platforms, which absorbs heaving liftings of solving recurring technical problems into the platform layer, and free up developers to focus on business features.
Focus the future state architecture across public cloud and on premise infrastructure at the conceptual and logical level, and partner closely with platform engineering, and infrastructure teams to translate into physical design.
Design and oversee the operating model for platform and infrastructure architecture across multiple teams, ensuring clear ownership, decision rights, review forums, and lifecycle accountability for enterprise technology platforms.
Spearhead M&A technology due diligence, integration planning, execution of integrating infrastructure and technology landscape between T Rowe Price and target entities.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning and Development:
Develop and maintain the technical platform and infrastructure architecture strategy and roadmap.
Ensure alignment of platform architecture with the organization’s business objectives and IT strategy to increase speed of delivery.
Ensure alignment of infrastructure architecture with the organization’s business growth ambition for scalability and flexibility.
Advise and provide consulting for new technologies to modernize infrastructure capabilities and improve efficiency.
Make architecture decisions guided by long-term business strategy, enterprise priorities, risk posture, and approved operating plans, balancing near-term delivery needs with long-term scalability, resiliency, and total cost of ownership.

Architecture Design and Implementation:
Lead the design and deployment of robust, scalable, and secure technology platforms and infrastructure.
Ensure technical platforms and infrastructure adhere to enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
Oversee the integration of various platforms and infrastructure components within the enterprise technology landscape.

Leadership and Collaboration:
Provide leadership and direction to architects, engineers, and technology leaders, including leadership through subordinate managers or senior technical leads, to deliver enterprise platform and infrastructure outcomes across multiple teams.
Collaborate with IT leaders, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure the successful delivery of platform and infrastructure modernization projects.
Provide expert guidance on technology platform and infrastructure architecture to various teams within the organization.
Build and maintain a wide internal and external network across business, technology, vendor, and industry communities, leveraging those relationships to influence architecture direction and deliver outcomes.

Governance and Compliance:
Establish and enforce policies, standards, and guidelines for technology platform and infrastructure architecture.
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies for all platform and infrastructure solutions.
Conduct regular reviews and audits of platform and infrastructure architecture to ensure compliance and identify improvement opportunities.
Articulate broader business, risk, control, and regulatory considerations impacting platform and infrastructure architecture, including data privacy, resiliency, cybersecurity, financial controls, and applicable regulatory expectations.
Establish and manage architecture review practices for major platform and infrastructure initiatives, ensuring in-flight work remains aligned to enterprise standards, target-state architecture, risk requirements, and business objectives.

Continuous Improvement:
Drive continuous improvement initiatives in technology platform and infrastructure architecture, focusing on optimization and modernization.
Stay informed about the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies to maintain a competitive edge.
Implement best practices for platform and infrastructure performance tuning and optimization.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field and 12+ years of relevant technology experience, including 5+ years of management experience leading architecture, engineering, or technology teams in large, complex environments.
Proven experience leading technology platform architecture and infrastructure modernization projects in large, complex environments, and managing team of architects.
Deep understanding of platform architecture, infrastructure design and engineering principles, patterns, and best practices.
Experience with a variety of technical platforms (e.g., APIM, Messaging Middleware, DevSecOps, Observability, Developer Portal or Experience Platform, etc ).
Experience with major enterprise software platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Workday, Appian, etc.)
Proficiency in multi-cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their platform services.
Knowledge of enterprise architecture patterns and practices (e.g., , design patterns for microservices, loosely coupled architecture, DevSecOps practices, etc. ).
Experience with a variety of infrastructure technologies (e.g., networks, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud services).
Proficiency in a multi-cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and related services.
Demonstrated ownership of one or more enterprise architectural disciplines, with accountability for standards, roadmaps, lifecycle decisions, a nd long-term operational outcomes.
Extensive experience in M&A IT due diligence, integration planning and execution.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, guide teams and develop global teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders while building trust
Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.
Demonstrated commitment to building, developing, mentoring, and retaining technical talent, while fostering inclusive partnerships and a culture of collaboration across architecture and engineering teams.

Preferred

TOGAF 9 Enterprise Architecture Practitioner certification.
Experience with DevSecOps practices, developer tools, infrastructure, and data center operations.
Knowledge of security and compliance standards relevant to technology platforms and infrastructure components.

FINRA Requirements

FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role.

Work Flexibility

This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home.

Job Description

About FIS

FIS is a leading provider of technology solutions for financial institutions and businesses of all sizes and across all industries — in the world. We empower the financial world by enabling the movement of money, processing trillions of dollars annually, and powering thousands of banks, capital markets firms, and merchants globally. Our Technology organization is the engine behind that mission, building the platforms, infrastructure, and digital experiences that move the global economy forward.

Position Summary

The Vice President, Head of Money Movement engineering is a senior executive within the FIS Technology organization, accountable for leading the product development of money movement, including a wide range of solutions, such as ACH, FedNow, real-time payments, instant payments, retail payments, commercial payments, and cross-border payments. This leader will set technical strategy and direction for money movement, modernize product delivery and architecture, scale product and solution for growth, and ensure high availability, observability, resiliency and recovery. This leader will partner closely with technology, business, product, and operation leaders to build and lead a high-performing organization of engineers and technical leaders.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

Adoption and scaling of AI-assisted development practices

Technical strategy in partnership with executive leadership
Engineering execution, delivery predictability, and operational excellence
Mentorship and growth of engineering leaders and senior technical talent

— hands-on background in systems or platform engineering
Strong understanding of distributed systems
, scalable backend architectures, and service design

in production environments
Experience leading teams building infrastructure, platform, or cybersecurity products

Track record of driving AI-native development workflows
and modern coding agent adoption at team or org scale

Background in network technologies
, infrastructure intelligence, or visibility platforms

, or enterprise security tooling
Experience in IT asset management
, OT environments, or enterprise infrastructure domains
Hands-on experience with Claude Code
, Cursor, Devin, or similar agentic development tools

Direct line to the CTO — real scope, real autonomy
AI-native from day one — this isn't a future initiative, it's how the org operates today

new_jobs.title: Director of Corporate Engineering
new_jobs.description:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for supporting and improving the equipment engineering strategy, asset management approach, maintenance efficiency, and overall equipment standards for all business units where Ports America has management control. In business units which Ports America has a minority stake the Director of Engineering will use all reasonable efforts to influence the engineering strategy and standards in line with Ports America established standards. This role will work closely with Maintenance, Procurement, Operations, IT and Legal departments for all equipment-related matters. The position is responsible for supporting and improving safety and environmental standards as well as enforcement within the engineering function in conjunction with the SVP of Health, Safety & Sustainability. The Director of Engineering will work closely to align standards and objectives with all business unit heads.

Essential Duties:

Direct, develop, communicate, and manage the group’s engineering strategies, performance, growth, and development needs to support overall cost and operational objectives as well as stakeholder expectations.
Participate and lead engineering and corporate Management meetings as required and appropriate.
Monitor, collaborate and support the equipment procurement program. Develop, refine, and implement equipment specifications and framework strategies to provide maximum cost benefits and equipment quality to Ports America.
Function as a subject matter expert and business liaison between engineering, procurement, HS&S, and other functions within the organization.
Lead, manage, communicate, and implement Ports America maintenance efficiencies, safety and environmental best practices, process improvements, cost saving initiatives, standardization in line with the group strategy, objectives, and expectations. Research for ‘continual process improvement’ initiatives and the latest technologies to support terminal operations.
Ensure companywide conformance and compliance with established Ports America engineering and corporate policies, procedures, safety & environmental, applicable legislation and regulatory institutions as appropriate, through controlled auditing and mentoring processes.
Support, improve and implementation of the company’s Asset Management program.
Promote and demonstrate positive behaviors in harmony with Ports America’s values and culture.
Ensure that the highest levels of safety are applied in all activities.
Understand and adhere to Ports America Code of Conduct and Ethics policies.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Physical Working Attributes:

Maneuver on a ship, terminal yard, crane, area buildings and terminal equipment. This includes occasional stairs, ladders, height, small spaces, and proximity to rotating equipment, stored energy, deep water and large machines.
Frequent sitting, occasional standing and walking.
Some environments may be hazardous to persons unable to see or hear fast moving heavy equipment.

Minimum Requirements:

Bachelors Degree in Engineering
Combination of education and experience may be considered.

10+ years of Engineering leadership experience that has encompassed any combination of the following:
Major capital equipment projects.
Container terminal engineering function.
Major engineering system implementation experience.
Asset Management development & implementation.
Nationally recognized engineering qualification

Knowledge of the container port industry with respect to all aspects of the engineering functions, cranes, port equipment, automation, maintenance management, computerized maintenance systems and integration of new technologies, methods or standards.
Detailed knowledge of reliability engineering and maintenance planning programs.

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters in Engineering and/or M.B.A
Ability to understand terminal operations, planning, and stevedore operations principles.
Knowledge of the container port industry with respect to all aspects of the engineering functions, cranes, port equipment, automation, computerized maintenance system and technologies, integrated technologies, methods, and standards.
Detailed knowledge of reliability engineering and maintenance planning programs recommended.
Excellent computer literacy.
Experience in stevedoring and marine terminal markets.
Experience with industry-related labor contracts.
Knowledge of safety and accident prevention codes and regulations.
Knowledge of industry-related regulatory codes and requirements.
Experience with profit and loss principles.
Requires the ability to communicate effectively with diverse customers and market base.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The employee may perform other related duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Ports America is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy); sexual orientation; gender identity and/or expression; age; disability; genetic information, citizenship status; military service obligations or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

new_jobs.title: Director, Engineering
new_jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Director, Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, modernization, and ongoing support of enterprise technology solutions that enable the firm’s legal and business operations.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for software engineering, application development, and systems integration, and engineering delivery functions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable and aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities.

The Director, Engineering partners closely with value stream leadership, IT services leaders, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality technology capabilities that improve attorney and business professional productivity, enhance client experience, and support revenue growth and operational efficiency.

This role is accountable for engineering execution discipline, technical quality, delivery reliability, and the evolution of reusable engineering and platform capabilities that accelerate the firm's transition to a build-capable technology organization.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Provide strategic leadership for engineering and application development teams supporting firmwide legal and business capabilities across value streams.
Set technical direction, architectural standards, and engineering practices to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and operationally sustainable.
Partner closely with IT, legal operations, and business stakeholders to translate business outcomes and value stream priorities into executable technology roadmaps and engineering delivery strategy, keeping a user experience and product value mindset at the forefront.
Lead engineering execution and continuous delivery of technology capabilities, balancing innovation, platform stability, technical debt reduction, risk management, and operational excellence.
Collaborate across IT functions to improve delivery flow, reduce bottlenecks, and increase engineering throughput and reliability.
Oversee engineering efforts across multiple product and platform workstreams, balancing innovation, operational stability, quality, risk, and delivery commitments.
Establish and promote engineering best practices including automation, CI/CD, observability, resiliency, testing, reusable engineering capabilities, and operational readiness.
Manage engineering budgets, vendor relationships, consultant resources, and third-party development partners as applicable to the success of the service portfolio and deliverables.
Lead, develop, and retain engineering management and senior technical talent, including performance management and succession planning.
Establish governance, metrics, and reporting for engineering performance, platform health, technical debt, operational sustainability, and delivery outcomes.
Ensure compliance with firm security, risk, governance, privacy, and data protection standards across all engineering activities.
Partner with infrastructure, operations, SRE, and end-user support teams to ensure stable production operations and smooth lifecycle support for delivered capabilities.
Provides leadership to and manages a team of business professionals to include coaching, mentoring and professional development. Responsible for providing performance feedback on a regular basis.

Desired Skills

Enterprise application architecture and modern development practices. Strategic planning and execution in complex environments. People leadership and organizational development. Financial and vendor management. Stakeholder partnership and executive communication. Risk management, security awareness, and operational excellence.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree in Technology, business, or management‑related discipline.

Certifications

Relevant certifications in cloud platforms, architecture, or technology leadership are preferred.

Minimum Years Of Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering or application development, including at least five years in a senior leadership or management role overseeing multiple teams or portfolios.

Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties;
Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner;
Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;
Foster positive work relationships;
Comply with all firm policies and practices;
Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.   

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Disclaimer   

The purpose of this job description is to provide a concise statement of the work elements and to organize and present the information in a standardized way. It is not intended to describe all the elements of the work that may be performed by every individual in this classification, nor should it serve as the sole criteria for personnel decisions and actions. The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Application Process    

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

Accommodation   

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to permit individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position or to participate in the job selection process. If you have a request for an accommodation during the application process, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.    

No immigration sponsorship is available for this position.   

The firm’s expected hiring range for this position is $168,478 - $272,949 depending on the candidate’s geographic market location.

The compensation offered for employment will also be dependent on other factors including the candidate’s experience, skills, educational and professional background, and overall qualifications. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance, and 401(k).

Applicants who are not based in the jurisdiction in which this position is posted and who apply for this role are doing so voluntarily and are not eligible for relocation assistance. Any relocation benefits, if any, are provided only where a relocation is required at the firm’s direction and in accordance with applicable policy and law.

DLA Piper is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Job applicant poster viewing center .

This is where
your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Advancing Healthcare Through Innovation

At Baxter, we are deeply connected by our mission. Every role at Baxter contributes to improving outcomes for patients around the world. As a Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering, you will play a critical leadership role in driving manufacturing excellence, supporting new product introductions, and helping deliver life-saving medical products with quality, efficiency, and innovation at the center of everything we do.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic and hands-on engineering leader who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and is passionate about leading teams, driving continuous improvement, and enabling operational success.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead and develop a team with varied strengths of manufacturing engineers and technicians, supporting a collaborative, inclusive, and achievement-focused culture.
Provide coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to support team growth and engagement.
Partner with senior leadership to define and implement the engineering roadmap supporting SKF products and manufacturing operations.
Oversee the design, implementation, optimization, and transfer of manufacturing processes for new and existing products.
Improve productivity, reduce waste, enhance product quality, and support operational efficiency initiatives.
Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies to identify and implement sustainable process improvements.
Lead multiple engineering projects that span multi-functional areas from concept through implementation.
Develop project timelines, resource plans, budgets, and risk mitigation strategies to ensure successful execution.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with quality and compliance requirements.
Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and Operations teams to align manufacturing strategies with business objectives.
Serve as a key liaison between Manufacturing Engineering and members of multi-functional teams to support effective communication and project alignment.
Support compliance with FDA, ISO, cGMP, and Baxter quality standards across manufacturing operations.
Conduct process reviews, audits, and performance evaluations to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and compliance enhancement.
Champion a strong culture of quality, safety, and operational excellence..
Manage engineering-related budgets and resource allocation to maximize operational performance and return on investment.
Monitor key performance metrics and communicate project updates, business results, and improvement opportunities to leadership.
Build strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, including suppliers and customers.
Promote Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) compliance and proactively contribute to Baxter’s commitment to zero harm in the workplace.
Stay informed on emerging manufacturing technologies and industry trends to support innovation and best-practice implementation.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering field. Master’s degree experience in Engineering or related field.
8+ years of manufacturing engineering experience, preferably within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or healthcare industry.
Demonstrated success leading engineering teams and managing complex manufacturing or process improvement projects.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing operations, quality systems, and regulated environments.
Knowledge of FDA, ISO, cGMP, and regulated manufacturing environments.
Strong leadership and people development skills
Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities
Excellent communication and partner management skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement mindset
Strong collaboration and multi-functional partnership skills.
PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other project/process improvement certifications.
Experience with CAD software, simulation tools, and manufacturing data analysis.

Work Environment

Combination of office, manufacturing, and laboratory-based work environments.
Regular interaction with cross-functional teams in collaborative settings.
Occasional travel may be required for manufacturing site visits, customer meetings, or industry events.
Use of standard office technology, engineering systems, and manufacturing tools.
Adherence to PPE and safety protocols in manufacturing and laboratory environments.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. Join Twitch's Product Core Engineering team and help power the future of our innovative, global platform. As a Sr. Engineering Manager for the Android Platform team, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic vision and execution for Twitch's cutting-edge mobile experiences.

Our mission is to empower engineers to build delightful, secure, and reliable experiences for our passionate communities worldwide. You'll be a key driver of this vision, leading a talented team that delivers the core tools, services, and frameworks that Twitch Builders leverage to innovate on the Android platform. Collaborate cross-functionally to identify new opportunities, align on priorities, and deliver seamless mobile experiences that wow our users. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on the Twitch platform and the millions of creators and communities we serve. If you're a seasoned Android expert with a passion for building game-changing mobile products, we want to hear from you!

You can work from San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; or New York, NY.

Nurture the careers of your talented engineers, empowering them to reach new levels of growth and success.

5+ years of professional mobile software development experience.
