new_jobs.description:
The field of gene therapy is growing rapidly and Genezen is here to meet the exacting needs of our clients. We provide process development, produce GMP viral vectors, and provide cell transduction for gene and cell therapy clinical trials and are proud to be a part of the process that leads to new cures.

WORKING AT GENEZEN

Many people have worked in environments where you feel like just another nameless part of an enormous machine. Genezen is different. We want our employees to be innovative, collaborative problem solvers who are dedicated to meeting the challenges of working at a fast-growing company. We are dedicated to empowering our employees to be their best and making Genezen a rewarding place to work. Every employee contributes to the success of the company and you can be part of that team.

JOB SUMMARY

The Process Engineering Manager/Sr. Manager is responsible for leading the process engineering department at Genezen’s Lexington facility. The incumbent will act as the key decision maker implementing program enhancements and overseeing equipment onboarding and process improvements. The candidate will establish goals and priorities their staff and act as the primary liaison between both internal customers and external service providers. The Process Engineering Manager/Sr. Manager will represent Engineering as the subject matter expert for all engineering related topics during client facing project meetings and be responsible for the department deliverables.

Represent department at client and cross functional meetings serving as the key stakeholder for all process engineering related topics.
Drives necessary equipment, control system, and facility improvement projects, providing oversight of design, construction, testing, and turnover with responsibility for schedule, budget, and overall project performance.
Provide technical input for product tech transfers, evaluation of process requirements versus facility capabilities.
Provide technical support and analysis for the resolution of deviations, investigations, and process issues.
Works independently to develop department procedures, standards, and specifications.
Manage and mentor engineering staff providing clear direction, expectations and goal setting.
Maintain team metrics related to on-time delivery and provide routine status updates to management.
Perform goal setting and period performance reviews of direct reports in alignment with corporate objectives.
Adaptability required as work schedule may change based on business needs
Criminal background check required

new_jobs.title: Sr. Director, Data Engineering + Integrations
new_jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it’s within reach.

What Will You Do?

The Overview

The Director/Sr. Director, Data Engineering will lead and scale Prolaio’s healthcare data engineering capabilities that power its clinical intelligence products, real-world data pipelines, analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and data services in a regulated environment, building secure, reliable, and AI-enabled data platforms that transform continuous, predictive, and shareable heart data into faster therapeutic discovery and better cardiovascular outcomes while operating as a self-starter senior leader in a growth-stage company. This role will ensure that core data engineering features and services are built with security, privacy, compliance, and auditability by design, and other regulatory expectations relevant to Prolaio’s clinical and patient-data environment. This role will partner with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Quality, Clinical Operations to embed security, privacy, HIPAA and regulatory expectations into every layer of the data engineering features. This is a role for a self-starter and experienced engineering leader who brings both organizational leadership and strong technical credibility in designing, building, and continuously enhancing data engineering and AI-enabled data pipeline features in a growth-stage company.

The Specifics

Lead Prolaio’s enterprise data engineering strategy and roadmap to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable data platform capabilities aligned to clinical, research, product, and AI priorities in regulated healthcare settings.
Architect and oversee end-to-end data flows and reusable pipelines for ingestion, validation, transformation, enrichment, publishing, retention, archival, and decommissioning across batch, streaming, and hybrid workloads.
Own the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and interoperable data platforms that support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured clinical, operational, device, and patient-generated data relevant to Prolaio’s cardiovascular mission.
Define and enforce engineering standards for data modeling, lifecycle management, lineage, provenance, traceability, and auditability, embedding HIPAA, privacy, security, and GxP-aligned practices into day-to-day development workflows.
Partner closely with Data Architecture to design and govern conceptual, logical, and physical data models, apply healthcare standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OMOP, CDISC), and deliver analysis-ready, interoperable datasets.
Build and evolve robust data engineering capabilities across modern cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure) and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse), including orchestration, metadata, APIs, and integration patterns.
Lead the development of AI-enabled data engineering features such as intelligent data quality monitoring, metadata enrichment, semantic search, feature generation workflows, and automation that accelerate analytics, data science, and clinical research teams.
Collaborate with Quality, Clinical Operations, Security, Product, and Engineering to embed validation, change management, governed data access, master data management, and release readiness into the data platform lifecycle.
Establish and manage high-performing data engineering teams, providing clear ownership, coaching, and execution discipline suited to a fast-moving growth-stage environment, while influencing architecture and implementation decisions across a matrixed organization.
Support vendor and tool evaluation, including build-versus-buy decisions for data integration, quality, metadata, lineage, interoperability, and AI-enabled data management capabilities.

Why Prolaio?

Impactful Work:
You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
Innovative Environment:
You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
Professional Growth:
You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
Collaborative Team:
You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of experience in healthcare, medtech, life sciences, digital health, or another patient-focused environment, with meaningful responsibility for data platforms, platform engineering, or cloud-native enterprise platforms.
At least 7 years of experience as a Director or Sr. Director (or equivalent senior leadership role) leading data engineering or closely related data platform teams in growth-stage or innovation-driven organizations.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering healthcare data platforms that support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, with proven success in regulated or validated environments.
Deep understanding of healthcare data domains (clinical trials, cardiovascular and physiological data, real-world data, claims, medication, socio-economic and behavioral data) and the application of healthcare terminologies and common data models (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OMOP, CDISC).
Proven experience designing and operating end-to-end data flows, scalable pipelines, lineage, provenance, traceability, and data lifecycle management that support product, analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and data services use cases.
Strong familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, or comparable environments, including hands-on work with orchestration, APIs, and integration.
Strong software engineering and data engineering experience with Python and SQL and at least one of Java or .NET, with a track record of building internal data platform features, services, and developer tooling; experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular or React) is good to have. Experience in developing Agentic pipelines would be a plus.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional, matrixed organizations, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Clinical Operations, Quality, and Security, with a self-starter mindset and comfort with ambiguity in a growth-stage environment.
Familiarity with metadata, lineage, catalog, governance, and AI-enablement tools, including platforms for semantic indexing, vectorization, retrieval, and data lifecycle automation, and experience implementing governed data access and privacy-aware architectures.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Meaningful Compensation
: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build.
Great Health Coverage:
Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions.
Flexible Spending Perks:
HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual Lifestyle Spending Account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more.

Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays.
Family-First Benefits
: Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families.
Security & Peace of Mind
: Company-paid life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
Plan for the Future
: 401(k) plan to help you build long-term financial security.
Care When You Need It:
Easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life’s unexpected moments.

La Rabida Children’s Hospital provides specialized, family-centered health care to children with medically complex conditions, disabilities, and chronic illness. Through expertise, compassion, and advocacy we help children and their families reach their fullest potential, regardless of their ability to pay.

Our not-for-profit hospital, licensed for 49 beds, helps transition children from neonatal or pediatric intensive care to home, by providing medical, rehabilitative and developmental care, and by training families to continue treatments and manage the necessary equipment in the home. La Rabida also provides extensive rehabilitation for those recovering from wounds or burns and treatment for exacerbations of chronic conditions.

The hospital’s enhanced pediatric patient-centered medical home provides primary care to children with complex medical conditions and their siblings. Children with medical homes elsewhere come to La Rabida for specialty services. La Rabida offers a wide range of specialty services provided to children with sickle cell disease, diabetes, and many others. Children are supported in their emotional and developmental growth, particularly in cases where such growth has been interrupted by accident or disease.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager – Real Estate Technology Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
Overview

When you join Hines, you will embark on a career journey fueled by vision and guided by leaders who set the standards of our industry. Our legacy is rooted in innovation and excellence, earning us a spot on Fast Company’s esteemed annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, as well as recognition as one of U.S. News & World Report’s Best Companies to Work For in 2024. Discover endless opportunities to grow and make your mark at Hines.

Responsibilities

Hybrid position requiring at least three days per week in-office in downtown Houston

Leveraging an AI-first approach, the Senior Manager - Real Estate Technology Infrastructure will be a bridge between our global company vision and the physical technology deployed across our international portfolio. You will ensure that our buildings are "smart by design" by managing the vendor ecosystem, establishing technical standards, and contributing the delivery of complex strategic projects. Your focus will be on the Operational Technology (OT) stack, building the processes and partnerships to ensure our buildings are secure, integrated, and future-ready. In this individual contributor position, you provide strategic ownership of the design, validation, and enforcement of building network and infrastructure standards across our property portfolio. The position balances architectural standards, delivery governance, and escalation ownership to ensure infrastructure platforms are secure, resilient, and aligned with business needs. This role reports to the Managing Director, Real Estate Technology Infrastructure.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Strategic Sourcing: Identify, vet, and manage global and regional vendors for building automation, networking, security systems, and related.
Performance Gover nance: Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for third-party service providers.
Contract Management: Partner with Strategic Sourcing to negotiate enterprise-wide agreements that leverage our 25-country+ scale to drive cost efficiencies. Evaluate vendor proposals, quotes, licensing models, and support options; develop comparison materials and provide cost-risk tradeoff analysis to support leadership decision-making. Develop and maintain infrastructure standards for building networks, cybersecurity, and integrated systems to ensure consistency across all regions.
Standardization: Create technical design guidelines that architects and general contractors must follow during the development or retrofit phase. Own the design, validation, and enforcement of building network and infrastructure standards for property environments, including wireless, switching, firewalls, and site connectivity. Incorporate security and risk considerations into infrastructure architecture decisions, including firewall design, redundancy models, failover strategies, and secure remote administration.
Cross-Functional Liaison: Act as a technical lead between Technology, Management Services, Engineering, and Construction teams. Maintain portfolio-level visibility of infrastructure deployments, site readiness, remediation efforts, and transition status using enterprise service and project management tools. Ensure complete and accurate documentation, inventories, and configuration records are maintained to support audits, investigations, incident response, and ongoing operations. Support infrastructure requirements for physical security systems, building automation systems, and other safety-critical environments.
Cybersecurity: Securing "connected" building assets, implementing network segmentation, and managing vulnerability patching for hardware. Security Control Systems: Standards for IP-CCTV, cloud-based Access Control, and visitor management systems. Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
You will contribute to oversight and governance across the following critical OT areas: Building Integration & Automation: BMS/BAS, lighting controls, and IoT sensor integration via protocols like BACnet, Modbus, and MQTT. Networking & Communications: Building LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi 6/7, 5G in-building solutions, and unified communications.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements include:

Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited institution preferred or equivalent years of direct experience required.
Professional Experience: 10–12 years of experience in OT infrastructure, specifically within the real estate or construction sectors.
Global Mindset: Proven track record of managing projects or vendors across multiple time zones and regulatory environments.
Practical experience leveraging AI tooling to realize insight and efficiency.
Significant experience in operational infrastructure, network architecture, or technology operations supporting distributed environments.
Demonstrated experience designing and supporting enterprise network and wireless architectures, including firewalls, VPNs, redundancy, and failover models.
Experience supporting construction projects, property portfolios, or multi-site environments with active renovations and transitions preferred.
Strong working knowledge of vendor and ISP coordination, technical oversight, and commercial evaluation.
Project Management: Proficiency with tools like Procore, Bluebeam Revu, Jira, or Smartsheet is a plus.
Technical Literacy: Deep understanding of how physical building systems (HVAC, elevators, utility meters) intersect with digital networks.
Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
Ability and willingness to provide hands-on technical support when required while maintaining strong ownership, accountability, and communication practices.
Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced, and high-pressure environments with cross-functional stakeholders.
Willingness to provide occasional after-hours support for escalations or critical activities and to travel periodically in support of key projects or sites.
Strong working knowledge of OT/IT networking inc. converged networks, and typical connected building systems (i.e., BAS, BMS, ACS, CCTV).
Base competency of modern building systems & “smart” infrastructure.
Strong working knowledge of wireless technologies (i.e., DAS, managed Wi-Fi) preferred.
Strong working knowledge of OT/IT cybersecurity frameworks, principles, and strategies.
Network/communications certifications (i.e., CCNP, CCIE, CWNA) preferred.
Strong cross-functional leadership and project management/stakeholder management.
Proficiency with tools like Procore, Bluebeam Revu, Jira, or Smartsheet is a plus.
Most duties shall be performed in an office setting at Hines’ HQ office in Houston.
The nature of this role will require occasional work outside of Houston business hours to support escalations or critical activities in other regions..
Domestic and international travel will be required periodically (less than 10% of the time) in support of key projects or sites. Travel assignments to certain sites may include requirements to wear provided personal protective equipment (PPE) and may include activities performed in a non-office environment, including outdoors.

Closing

At Hines, we strive for excellence as a leading global real estate investment manager, driven by our by our belief that real estate is fundamentally about people. Our diverse portfolio spans $93.2 billion¹ of assets across such property types as living, office, retail, mixed-use, logistics and life science projects – all designed to enhance value, connection and inspiration. Our strategic approach integrates local expertise with global knowledge, taking calculated risks aligned with our convictions to exceed expectations and tailor solutions to our clients' needs.

While our projects are renowned for enhancing cities and pioneering sustainable practices, we recognize that the true driving force behind Hines' success is our 5,000 dedicated employees in 30 countries who draw on our 65-year history to build the world forward. This is why we prioritize investing in our people, offering comprehensive training, competitive compensation, robust benefits and generous vacation packages. By centering our focus on the growth and wellbeing of our team, we cultivate an inclusive environment where everyone, including our clients, can thrive.

Hines is proud to be named to Fast Company’s prestigious annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2024. ¹Includes both the global Hines organization and RIA AUM as of December 31, 2023.

We are an equal opportunity employer and support workforce diversity.

No calls or emails from third parties at this time please.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is seeking a visionary Senior Director of Product Strategy to join our Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a rare opportunity to sit at the intersection of product vision, market intelligence, and technical architecture — helping define not just what Salesforce builds next, but why and how.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Product Strategy, you will serve as a key architect of our forward-looking product innovation agenda. You will lead and grow a team of product strategists charged with identifying emerging white spaces, evaluating build-buy-partner options, and translating complex technical and market dynamics into clear, executable product strategies.

This role goes well beyond traditional corporate strategy. We are not looking for someone who reacts to the latest headlines or incoming M&A signals. We are building a team that gets ahead of trends — a group that proactively surfaces what Salesforce might be missing, stress-tests assumptions, and shapes the decisions that will define our product platform for the next decade.

From guiding the productization of emerging internal capabilities — spanning trust infrastructure, workflow automation, and agentic AI architectures — to framing investment theses around high-growth sectors like supply chain agentification, developer tooling, and AI-native systems of record, you will ensure Salesforce is building the right things, at the right time, with the right model.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Lead product strategy for forward-looking innovation, whitespace identification, and productization planning across Salesforce's AI and platform portfolio.
Drive product strategy for emerging offerings moving from internal capability to standalone or platform-integrated product — including trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI systems, and data platforms.
Own and evolve a strategic framework for evaluating build-buy-partner decisions, including how and when to integrate acquired technologies into the core Salesforce platform versus taking them to market independently.
Proactively identify and assess game-changing market shifts — including the agentic coding revolution, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open source commercialization trends — and translate these into actionable investment recommendations.
Partner closely with the SVP to define 'what are we missing' across the product portfolio, filling gaps in strategic coverage that go beyond what reactive competitive intelligence can provide.
Synthesize inputs from engineering, product management, research, M&A, and external sources to develop clear, evidence-based points of view on where Salesforce should place strategic bets.
Perform quantitative and competitive analytics to size market opportunities, assess competitive positioning, and support investment recommendations with data-driven evidence.
Partner with regional leadership to expand Salesforce's product strategy footprint into European markets, accounting for local regulatory requirements, competitive dynamics, and go-to-market nuances.
Evaluate productization models — open source, platform-bundled, standalone SaaS, API-first — and build decision-making frameworks that account for monetization, competitive dynamics, and developer adoption.
Monitor venture investment trends, startup ecosystem signals, and technical research to stay ahead of emerging paradigms before they become conventional wisdom.
Present strategic recommendations and options to the SVP and cross-functional executives in a clear, structured, and data-supported manner.
Build and mentor a high-performing strategy team, establishing processes for ongoing horizon scanning, opportunity assessment, and strategic synthesis.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a Director-level Individual Contributor in Product Management to lead the strategy, development, and execution of our deployment and operational platform for Connetic, the next generation payment innovation from ACI Worldwide.

This role blends product leadership, DevOps strategy, and cloud-first deployment expertise, with responsibility for enabling secure, scalable, cloud-native and hybrid deployments across on-premises, private cloud, and SaaS environments.

You will define how mission-critical payment software is delivered, deployed, upgraded, and operated globally, across multi-cloud and enterprise environments, working across engineering, global markets, SRE, and customer-facing teams. This is a hands-on strategic role requiring deep technical fluency in cloud platforms, distributed systems, and deployment automation, and the ability to influence without direct authority.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership
Drive the product definition, roadmap, and solution plans for deployment platforms, cloud infrastructure capabilities, and operational tooling.
Develop and maintain multi-year (3–5 year) product strategy and annual operating plans for DevOps, cloud deployment, and platform capabilities.
Define business cases and investment priorities based on market analysis, cloud adoption trends, and customer needs across SaaS and self-managed environments.

DevOps, Cloud & Platform
Own product vision for DevOps and cloud-enabled deployment tooling, including:
Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and GitOps models
CI/CD pipelines and release orchestration across environments
Environment provisioning across multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-prem
Configuration management and secrets management
Observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting)
Define standards for cloud-native architectures, including containerization (Kubernetes), service mesh, and microservices deployment patterns.
Establish automation frameworks to enable consistent, repeatable deployments across SaaS, hybrid, and on-prem environments.
Drive improvements in deployment velocity, reliability, cost efficiency, and operational resilience.

On-Prem, SaaS & Cloud Deployment Strategy
Define and deliver deployment models supporting:
Cloud-native SaaS platforms (multi-tenant and single-tenant)
Hybrid and multi-cloud deployments
Private cloud and on-premise (including air-gapped environments)
Design for portability across cloud providers and customer-managed infrastructure.
Own versioning, upgrade strategies, patching, blue/green and canary releases, and backward compatibility across environments.
Ensure architectures support:
High availability and fault tolerance
Disaster recovery and geo-redundancy
Elastic scalability and workload isolation in cloud environments
Ensure deployment and cloud architecture supports high-performance payment processing, including:
Wires, real-time payments, cards, and ACH
Low latency and high throughput requirements
Regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, regional compliance, data residency)
End-to-end encryption and secure key management
Partner with professional services, solution consulting, application, and payment product teams to ensure seamless delivery across all deployment models.

Customer & Market Engagement
Engage directly with enterprise customers, partners, and implementation teams to understand deployment, cloud adoption, and operational challenges.
Translate customer feedback, cloud migration needs, and market trends into actionable product capabilities.
Partner with Sales and Marketing on go-to-market strategy, including positioning cloud vs on-prem offerings, sales enablement, and customer adoption strategies.

Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate with:
Engineering (platform, cloud infrastructure, and application teams)
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Security, Compliance, and Risk
Professional Services / Implementation
Influence architecture decisions to ensure deployability, operability, scalability, and cloud readiness are core design principles.
Act as a key bridge between platform engineering and customer-facing delivery teams.

Operational & Financial Accountability
Define and track key KPIs:
Deployment success rate
Release frequency and cycle time
Environment provisioning time
Cloud infrastructure utilization and efficiency
Drive continuous improvement through automation, telemetry, and data-driven insights.
Contribute to cost optimization strategies, particularly in cloud infrastructure and SaaS operations.
Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in Product Management, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related roles.
Proven experience managing enterprise software deployments across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem environments.
Strong knowledge of:
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
DevOps practices and tools (CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, etc.)
Distributed systems and microservices architectures
Experience with cloud-native and hybrid deployment models.

Competencies

Deep systems thinker with strong cloud, platform, and architectural expertise
Customer-first mindset with strong empathy for enterprise deployment and cloud migration challenges
Strong analytical and business case development skills
Ability to influence without authority and operate at executive level
High ownership with a bias toward execution, scalability, and measurable outcomes

Preferred Qualifications (Education, Experience, Competencies)

Experience in payments, fintech, or regulated industries.
Familiarity with:
PCI-DSS, SOC2, and compliance-driven product development
Data residency and sovereign cloud considerations
Experience driving cloud transformation or SaaS platform adoption.
Proven ability to influence large, cross-functional organizations as a senior IC.

Hybrid work environment
Majority of time spent on PC (Phys. Req.)

Ensure Accountability:
holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
Drives Results:
consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
Cultivate Innovation:
creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
Collaborates:
building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.

stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

15 years of economic development experience within a corporate organization (e.g., tax, policy, legal, real estate, etc.), law firm, accounting firm, consultancy, or government agency.
10 years of experience in contract negotiations.
10 years of experience developing business to business partnerships.

Preferred qualifications:

10 years of experience working in a commercial environment showcasing strength in B2B growth (GTM).

About The Job

As Director, Data Center Ecosystem, you will combine your market and tech industry knowledge to support Google's infrastructure growth. You will be a commercial leader who will help facilitate managed growth in data center locations. In addition, you will be part of a core team advising localized leadership of managed growth expectations and infrastructure demands. Your knowledge of economic development, compliance, relationship and coalition building, policy and regulation, and company goals will position you to be an advocate for development and management of the global data center portfolio.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Director/Enterprise Architect - Product Strategy
new_jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is seeking a visionary Senior Director of Product Strategy to join our Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a rare opportunity to sit at the intersection of product vision, market intelligence, and technical architecture — helping define not just what Salesforce builds next, but why and how.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Product Strategy, you will serve as a key architect of our forward-looking product innovation agenda. You will lead and grow a team of product strategists charged with identifying emerging white spaces, evaluating build-buy-partner options, and translating complex technical and market dynamics into clear, executable product strategies.

This role goes well beyond traditional corporate strategy. We are not looking for someone who reacts to the latest headlines or incoming M&A signals. We are building a team that gets ahead of trends — a group that proactively surfaces what Salesforce might be missing, stress-tests assumptions, and shapes the decisions that will define our product platform for the next decade.

From guiding the productization of emerging internal capabilities — spanning trust infrastructure, workflow automation, and agentic AI architectures — to framing investment theses around high-growth sectors like supply chain agentification, developer tooling, and AI-native systems of record, you will ensure Salesforce is building the right things, at the right time, with the right model.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Lead product strategy for forward-looking innovation, whitespace identification, and productization planning across Salesforce's AI and platform portfolio.
Drive product strategy for emerging offerings moving from internal capability to standalone or platform-integrated product — including trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI systems, and data platforms.
Own and evolve a strategic framework for evaluating build-buy-partner decisions, including how and when to integrate acquired technologies into the core Salesforce platform versus taking them to market independently.
Proactively identify and assess game-changing market shifts — including the agentic coding revolution, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open source commercialization trends — and translate these into actionable investment recommendations.
Partner closely with the SVP to define 'what are we missing' across the product portfolio, filling gaps in strategic coverage that go beyond what reactive competitive intelligence can provide.
Synthesize inputs from engineering, product management, research, M&A, and external sources to develop clear, evidence-based points of view on where Salesforce should place strategic bets.
Perform quantitative and competitive analytics to size market opportunities, assess competitive positioning, and support investment recommendations with data-driven evidence.
Partner with regional leadership to expand Salesforce's product strategy footprint into European markets, accounting for local regulatory requirements, competitive dynamics, and go-to-market nuances.
Evaluate productization models — open source, platform-bundled, standalone SaaS, API-first — and build decision-making frameworks that account for monetization, competitive dynamics, and developer adoption.
Monitor venture investment trends, startup ecosystem signals, and technical research to stay ahead of emerging paradigms before they become conventional wisdom.
Present strategic recommendations and options to the SVP and cross-functional executives in a clear, structured, and data-supported manner.
Build and mentor a high-performing strategy team, establishing processes for ongoing horizon scanning, opportunity assessment, and strategic synthesis.

You're Our Person If

12+ years of experience spanning product management, product strategy, technology strategy, or innovation roles — preferably at an enterprise software or cloud platform company.
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams of 3 or more strategists, researchers, or product managers in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Deep working knowledge of AI and machine learning architectures, including agentic systems, LLM-based applications, and AI integration patterns within enterprise platforms.
Strong understanding of systems of record, data platforms, and enterprise application architectures, including how AI layers are introduced into or layered atop traditional SaaS infrastructure.
Fluency in evaluating productization strategies, including trade-offs between open source, proprietary, platform-native, and standalone go-to-market models.
Experience participating in or supporting M&A strategy, including acquisition thesis development, integration planning, or build-buy-partner evaluation.
Ability to structure and communicate complex, multi-variable strategic analyses for senior executive audiences — in writing, in presentations, and in live discussions.
Comfort operating in contexts where the problem is not fully defined and the path forward requires both intellectual rigor and creative hypothesis generation.

Even Better If

Experience in product strategy or innovation roles at an AI-first company, an enterprise platform vendor, or a technology-focused management consulting firm.
Familiarity with agentic coding tools, developer platform ecosystems, and the competitive landscape around AI-assisted software development.
Knowledge of supply chain, operations, or vertical AI automation and process agentification at enterprise scale.
Track record of developing original investment or product theses — not simply synthesizing others' frameworks, but originating new points of view.
Exposure to venture capital, corporate development, or startup ecosystem dynamics, with the ability to translate investment signals into product strategy implications.
Builder's mindset: You are energized by creating new things — teams, frameworks, markets — not just running existing processes.
Experience working on both offensive (new market entry, new product launch) and defensive (competitive response, retention of strategic position) product strategies.
MBA, MS, or equivalent advanced degree in a relevant discipline is a plus; demonstrated outcomes matter more than credentials

LI-Y*

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

new_jobs.title: Director of Solutions Engineering, Enterprise East
new_jobs.description:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About The Role

Decagon is seeking a Director of Solutions Engineering to build and lead our growing pre-sales solutions engineering function. This role combines technical depth, enterprise consultative engagement, and team leadership, enabling Decagon to drive adoption of our AI-native platform across some of the world’s most complex enterprises.

As a manager of the Solutions Engineering team, you will be responsible for hiring, mentoring, and developing a high-performing team of Solutions Engineers. You’ll establish scalable processes and best practices for pre-sales engagements, ensure technical excellence in customer conversations, and represent Decagon as a senior technical leader on key opportunities.

This role is highly cross-functional: you will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design strategies that align technical capabilities with customer outcomes. You will also bring strong executive presence to customer engagements, guiding both technical and business stakeholders through how Decagon integrates into their technology environments and drives measurable business value.

In this role, you will

Hire, mentor, and manage a team of Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, coaching, and career development.
Establish and operationalize best practices for pre-sales solutioning, proof-of-concepts, and technical validation.
Partner with Sales leadership to co-develop go-to-market strategies and align technical execution with business goals.
Engage directly with a select portfolio of enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through discovery, solution design, and ROI validation.
Ensure your team delivers compelling demonstrations, prototypes, and solution engineers tailored to customer needs.
Foster cross-functional collaboration with Product and Engineering to bring customer insights into roadmap priorities.
Serve as an executive-level technical representative in customer meetings, technical workshops, and industry events.
Define scalable processes and assets to support team efficiency, repeatability, and long-term growth.
Stay current on enterprise AI adoption patterns, integration strategies, and the evolving competitive landscape.

Your background looks something like this

7+ years of experience in pre-sales technical roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or equivalent.
3+ years of experience managing or leading pre-sales/solutions engineering teams.
Proven success working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex buying cycles.
Strong technical proficiency with enterprise AI deployments, API integrations, and production system architectures.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, business stakeholders, and technical teams with equal credibility.
A collaborative, organizational mindset with a track record of building scalable teams and processes.
Ability to thrive in fast-moving, high-growth environments with significant ambiguity.
Strong executive presence and consultative skills, capable of establishing trust and credibility with senior leaders.

Even better if you have

Experience in AI/Generative AI pre-sales engineering or enterprise deployments.
Familiarity with enterprise architecture design, developer tooling, SDKs, and integration patterns.
Background in software engineering or systems engineering, enabling you to dive deeply into technical discussions.
Experience integrating telephony infrastructure or other complex enterprise systems.
Knowledge of LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, and AI-powered solution design.
Thought leadership experience through conferences, webinars, or published technical content.

Compensation

$320,000 - $400,000 + Offers Commission + Equity

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
Parental Leave
Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance
Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best
Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

Compensation Range: $320K - $400K
